releases.name: shadps4 v0.21.0 - codename Until Mavethee Dawn
releases.body:
Another week another release . There are ton of changes , so why not ? 

## Core
* Properly check where an input came from for digital->analog input smoothing
* cpu_patches: Work around Rosetta 2 mistranslating negated scalar compares 
* file_sys: Report stable file identities in stat and fstat 
* Allow file type identification for '/addcont' path
* emulator: stop clearing temporary data on boot 
* Add PT_SCE_MODULE_PARAM case
* cpu_patches: Fix JIT patching at addresses outside any module
* core: Fix MemoryManager::Free unmapping past the released rang
* file_sys: don't abort when a guest path goes through a regular file
* use VMA pointers instead of copies in TryWriteBacking 
* cpu_patches: Workaround Rosetta 2 crash on VMASKMOVPS/PD
* Handle ELF metadata and toolchain comments program headers
* common: reuse one high-resolution waitable timer per thread in AccurateSleep
* Don't abort when optional ELF metadata segments can't be read
* cpu_patches: Fix register clobbering in Rosetta 2 VMASKMOV workaround 
* renderdoc: Add library name for macOS
* renderdoc: Add alternate path for macOS 
* lru_cache: Fix early stop in ForEachItemBelow 
* Avoid deadlock when Shutdown is re-entered

releases.name: shadps4 v0.20.0 - codename Dead Or Stephen 5 - The Comeback
releases.body:
That was close wasn't it? I know you are not used to so close releases but we have a lot of new things to demonstrate so why not? This release is following the first official stable release of shadNet 0.1.0, so we have some online playability available (yes Bloodborne fans, online Bloodborne is now officially available). There are also a tons of fixes to different areas of emu , you can check the list below. The release is dedicated to our friend Stephen, who is taking a break from shadPS4 due of his studies. Stephen if you are reading this we already miss you ;/

## Core
* cpu_patches: Apply comprehensive SSE4a CPU patches on macOS 
* Shutdown NpHandler before restarting
* cpu_patches: Enable static patching on Linux
* cpu_patches: Patch (V)RCPPS and (V)RSQRTPS on Intel
* Speed up game ID resolution
* Anchor the FPS counter at startup and refactor counter movement check
* address_space: Restore protections after splitting a mapped region on Windows
* kernel: Implement POSIX file attribute and sync APIs
* file_sys: Normalize guest paths and fix mount matching
* Do not expand host mmap range during POSIX AddressSpace::Unmap
* Advance the source pointer for each backing run in TryWri

releases.name: shadps4 v0.19.0 - codename The Shadoween special
releases.body:
Welcome back to another shadPS4 release . It is over one month since our previous release and guess what we are back again with a lot more fixes and a lot more playable games . Rapid work has been done in different areas of the emu, but i guess the glory goes to the huge amount of GPU fixes that improved so many games, some of them are really playable now . I won't steal the fun of discovering these, so here is a brief list of changes.

### Core
- Rewrote signal emulation again 
- Fixed incorrect error return on attempting to create a file in a nonexistent folder in a writable mount 
- Fix reserved region coalescing in POSIX address space code 
- Support loading entitlements from RIF licenses 
- Optimized logger by replacing hash map with table lookup and hide implementation details 
- Support loading DLC as ZAR 
- Reworked slot vector 
- Fixed sceKernelReserveVirtualRange alignment and add ClearName 

### Libraries
- Use present scheduler for blank frame prepare 
- np_auth : Change default GetAuthorizationCode returns to be valid 
- np_trophy: Fixed displaying of trophy name 
- http2 : Fixes and cleanups
- np_tss : Added TSS support
- camera : Use a system mapping for camera frame

releases.name: shadps4 v0.18.0 - codename UltraPersona
releases.body:
shadPS4 v0.18.0 "UltraPersona"

Hello there, it hasn't been a while, has it? While not much time has passed since our last stable release, we are here again with a brand new one. The main reason for this release is broken shadNet authorization in certain cases on the 0.17.0 release, but we have some more interesting new features as well.

Firstly, after some fixes, AvPlayer can now be loaded as LLE, meaning that you need the `libSceAvPlayer.sprx` (and `libSceAvPlayerStreaming.sprx`) module(s), which makes broken videos in a few games now work properly.

The above change was enabled by calling `sceLibcInternalMemoryMutexEnable` in LLE LibcInternal at boot, found by [@liuk7071](https://github.com/liuk7071), the developer of ChonkyStation4, another PS4 emulator.

A kernel event flag rewrite has also fixed Shadow of the Colossus often hanging on boot, and the game now consistently gets to menus.

Another big feature is the experimental [red zone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red_zone_%28computing%29) protection, which fixes an issue specific to 12th generation and onwards Intel CPUs exclusively on Windows, that was causing crashes and other undefined behaviour in lots of games that we

_Please note that our version increases are landmarks and not stable builds_
**Always download the latest build from https://rpcs3.net/download**

**Note:** These are **NOT** stable builds. RPCS3 is a rolling release software without stable builds. These are random tags we do from time to time. Do **NOT** use the branch from these tags to package RPCS3.

---

## What's Changed
* fix emulator crash on crashed game window closure by @digant73 in https://github.com/RPCS3/rpcs3/pull/19122
* rsx/copypasta: Fix reversed 2-sided lighting input registers for FS stage by @digant73 in https://github.com/RPCS3/rpcs3/pull/19123
* Update FAudio to 26.08 by @Megamouse in https://github.com/RPCS3/rpcs3/pull/19125
* qt: reduce lines of code in settings_dialog by @Megamouse in https://github.com/RPCS3/rpcs3/pull/19130
* Fix vm::writer_lock deadlock-inducing usage on PPU by @elad335 in https://github.com/RPCS3/rpcs3/pull/19132
* Fix recording with fallback encoders by @Megamouse in https://github.com/RPCS3/rpcs3/pull/19136

## Downloads
- **`gamenative-v1.3.0-prerelease.apk`** — Standard build. Recommended for most users.
- **`gamenative-v1.3.0-prerelease-legacy-xr.apk`** — XR build for Quest headsets.


## What's Changed
* Added new Steam client in headless mode, fixing online multiplayer in several games (eg AoE II, CS), input in various games (eg No Man's Sky) and fixes DRM for games that were not working in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1937
* Added EA games support (tested with NFS: MW, Sims 4, Titanfall) - requires headless Steam client enabled
* Added Rockstar games support (tested with RDR2, GTA V Legacy, GTA IV, LA Noire) - requires headless Steam enabled
* Added Native Rust download engine (gn-download) + one-at-a-time download queue - should significantly speed up downloads by @joshuatam in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1913 and a few other PRs
* Significantly reduce container sizes by sharing components across containers (press Play on games to shrink their containers by up to 2GB each) in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2024
* Add native LSFG pipeline as default - should fix LSFG on most devices by @david-kalbermatten in https://github.c

emulators.description: Cemu - Wii U emulator
emulators.latest_body:
**Changelog:**
- Exporting saves via the title manager no longer crashes when the export path contains unicode characters
- Fixed a regression in DS Virtual Console titles (#1440)
- Fixed a bug where the debug shader dumping option would try to write files to the wrong directory
- Added a right-click context menu to the PPC debugger disassembly view and fixed some smaller bugs in the debugger
- Use libusb as the backend for HID/USB devices on Windows (#1471)
- Reduce amount of Vulkan sampler objects that are created. Reduces memory usage slightly and avoids crashes on drivers that have a low limit on sampler objects
- Improved index data caching on Vulkan. This may provide a very small performance benefit in some games
- The `--force-interpreter` command line option now always uses single-threaded CPU emulation like originally intended

releases.name: Cemu 2.6
releases.body:
**Changelog:**
- Exporting saves via the title manager no longer crashes when the export path contains unicode characters
- Fixed a regression in DS Virtual Console titles (#1440)
- Fixed a bug where the debug shader dumping option would try to write files to the wrong directory
- Added a right-click context menu to the PPC debugger disassembly view and fixed some smaller bugs in the debugger
- Use libusb as the backend for HID/USB devices on Windows (#1471)
- Reduce amount of Vulkan sampler objects that are created. Reduces memory usage slightly and avoids crashes on drivers that have a low limit on sampler objects
- Improved index data caching on Vulkan. This may provide a very small performance benefit in some games
- The `--force-interpreter` command line option now always uses single-threaded CPU emulation like originally intended

releases.name: Cemu 2.5
releases.body:
**Changelog:**
- Upscaling and downscaling options in the graphics settings now work correctly on Vulkan. Previously, the hermite and bicubic scaling options would only work on OpenGL and silently fall back to bilinear filtering on Vulkan
- Graphic pack support for custom scaling shaders has been reworked and is now functional on Vulkan, with fixes carrying over to OpenGL. If you are a graphic pack developer see #1392 for details
- Cemu will now show an error if the MLC directory is not writeable
- Added a workaround for graphic driver crashes seen in the eShop versions of Fatal Frame. These are caused by the game shipping with shaders that contain infinite loops. The actual hardware has an escape mechanism for this that we don't yet emulate
- Added support for connecting Wiimotes via L2CAP on Linux (Details in #1353)
- Set correct version for MacOS bundle
- Updated Arabic, German, Russian and Swedish translations

releases.name: Cemu 2.4
releases.body:
**Changelog:**
- Added emulated Dimensions Toypad
- Fixed a corruption bug which could occur when reading from titles in .app/.wud/.wux format under rare circumstances
- Cemu will now validate all reads for .app/.wud/.wux format titles and log any detected errors to log.txt. In the future we will also show these errors on screen
- Reworked the Wii U error dialog implementation (ErrEula) for better accuracy. This should fix the bug where sometimes the error dialog was unskippable in some games
- Fixed a bug in the HLE implementation of proc_ui.ProcUIRegisterCallback/ProcUIRegisterBackgroundCallback

releases.name: Cemu 2.3
releases.body:
**Changelog:**
- Vulkan: Fixed a race condition where uniform data could get corrupted. Most commonly this would cause polygon corruptions in BotW or XCX but in theory could affect every game
- Vulkan: Changes to how frame display is handled to reduce input latency
- Input: Fixed a crash that could occur when closing the add controller dialog while a controller search was still active
- Amiibo: Fixed an issue where Amiibo were not detected in Mario Kart 8
- Online: SpotPass functionality now respects the proxy_server option in settings.xml
- Windows: In portable mode shortcut save icons will now be stored to the Cemu directory instead of %appdata%
- Misc: Fixed a crash that could occur when invalid command line parameters were passed to Cemu

releases.name: Cemu 2.2
releases.body:
**Changelog:**
- Handle null timeout in `nsysnet.select`. Fixes a crash in Skylanders SuperChargers and Imaginators
- Fixed an issue where changing the `Receive untested updates` option would have no effect
- The Linux appimage version will use the system `libstdc++.so.6` if it is newer than the bundled file
- Updated French, Korean and Simplified Chinese translations

1.2.2 Changelog:
* Hotfix for an issue that caused bad frame pacing on some multi-monitor setups.

> [!NOTE]
Wondering about your save data when upgrading? Don't worry! Your save data is stored separately to the game itself. You can overwrite your old version and your save data will still be there, completely intact, and will work on the new version.

> [!NOTE]  
> **Intel GPU users:** Using outdated Intel drivers may cause the game to crash or cause graphical glitches. Please make sure your drivers are up-to-date before playing.

> Do not use your operating system or driver suite to check for driver updates, sometimes these updates are not distributed by vendors. Always check Intel's website for the latest drivers.

* New features for mod developers:
  * Added optional dependency functionality, which allows mods to run different code based on the presence of another mod. emulators.latest_body:
# Bloodborne PC 1.9.8.1

A fix for seamless co-op on top of 1.9.8.

## Fixed
- **Seamless co-op starts again with mods whose event files hold an empty event.** It stopped with "Making the co-op event files failed" (`event ...: its 0 instructions at -1 are outside the instruction table`). Event files written by mod tools can store an event with no instructions this way; the game reads nothing there, and now the co-op event patcher accepts them too.

The launcher makes the co-op event files again by itself on the next seamless start.

## Credits
Seamless co-op is **BBSC: Yharnam Together** by **[CLSAMG22](https://github.com/CLSAMG22)**: https://github.com/CLSAMG22/BBSC. This port runs BBSC's game files, co-op event patcher and HUD with its own engine and launcher, under BBSC's GPL-2.0 licence. BBSC's source is on its release page; this port's change to its event patcher is listed in `seamless\bbport-seamless.txt`. Thank you, CLSAMG22!

The source of this port's seamless engine (`bin\bb-probe-seamless.exe`) is attached to the 1.9.8 release.

releases.name: Bloodborne for Windows 1.9.6: online connection fix
releases.body:
A small update to 1.9.5 that fixes online play failing to connect on some PCs.

**Installing:** the launcher offers this update by itself. Or unpack it over 1.9.5 (or into a new, empty folder). Your settings and saves stay, and your shader cache is kept: no rebuild this time.

## Fixed
- **"Failed to connect to Bloodborne server. Returning to title menu." at Play Online on some PCs.** The log showed `certificate is not trusted by Windows either (error 0x1)` or `SSL server verification failed`, and trying again usually worked. The port now carries Let's Encrypt's root certificates (ISRG Root X1, X2, YE and YR) itself, so it trusts SuperMedo Server and The Hunter's Dream even on PCs where Windows hasn't downloaded them yet. And when its own check still fails, Windows' check now gets the server's whole certificate chain instead of only its first certificate, which could lead Windows to an expired certificate (that was the 0x1).

releases.name: Test build issue1165-test1 on 3.0.0: no audio
releases.body:
# Test build for no audio on some PCs (#1165)

This build is for players who have no sound at all on 3.0.0, with `No default audio device available` in `user/last_run.log`. It is not a final release.

## What changes

- When Windows reports no default audio device and SDL gives no driver name, the game now tries DirectSound before it goes silent. Before, that fallback only ran when the driver was named WASAPI.
- Everything else is 3.0.0.

## How to test

1. Copy your save folder first.
2. Extract `spartanport-windows.zip` into a **new folder**, so your current install stays as it is.
3. Start the game and check whether the intro and the gameplay have sound.
4. Reply on #1165 with **sound** or **still silent**, plus your `user/last_run.log`.

## Validation

- The new audio test failed before the fix and passes after it, together with the existing WASAPI fallback, forced driver and total failure tests, and the downmix test (MSYS2 CLANG64, warnings as errors).
- Built and opened on a clean Windows runner by the release workflow.
- Not checked in game: we could not reproduce a PC with no default audio device.

releases.body:
> **SpartanPort 3.0.0: the launcher is now Rust, with no Python.** Updating from 2.7.0 through the launcher keeps your saves and settings. These notes cover the 27 pull requests merged since 2.7.0, through `a2299cd` (#1150), including the version bump to 3.0.0. 2.8.0 was never published: its launcher work ships here.

## Updating from 2.7.0

- **Windows:** update through the launcher as usual. The 2.7.0 launcher downloads 3.0.0 and the new launcher installs itself over the old folder. Saves, `user/`, `spartanport.ini`, launcher settings, mods, patches and `last_run.log` are not touched. On its first start the new launcher removes the old Python files (`_internal/`, `run.py`, `scripts/*.py`); `scripts/controller_diagrams/` stays.
- **Linux:** download `spartanport-x86_64.AppImage` from this release and replace the old file. The launcher keeps offering updates from here on.
- **Settings carried over:** the launcher imports your previous settings. Shader notes in the corner stay **off**, and the new **High FPS Wall Seam Fix** patch is ticked once in a saved patch list; untick it and it stays unticked.
- **First start:** the shader cache is rebuilt once and each area can stutter the fi

releases.name: Test build issue1131-test2 on 2.8.0: infinite loading screens
releases.body:
# Test build 2 for infinite loading screens (#1131)

This build is for players stuck on a loading screen that never ends. It is not a final release: it tells us whether fixes that are not in 2.7.0 yet remove the hang, and if not, where the load stops.

## What changes

- **Memory fixes from #1005**, already on `main` but in no release yet. Among them, copy threads now read guest memory through a second view, so they no longer wait on a GPU thread that waits on them.
- **Texture cache, GPU and shader cache fixes from #1124.** On graphics cards with less than 8 GB, texture pressure now starts at 60% of the budget instead of about 40%, the collector no longer gets stuck behind images it must keep, and an old "GPU idle" signal can no longer release newer work.
- **Load diagnostics.** With `SPARTAN_FILE_TRACE=1` the log records every WAD file the game opens and reads. With `SPARTAN_LOAD_WATCHDOG=30` the log reports a load with no progress for 30 seconds and what every thread is doing. Both are off unless you turn them on.
- **New in test 2:** on Windows the watchdog now also records where in the game code each thread is stopped, and the functions it came from. This is what we need to fi

Hi everyone! I'm happy to announce a new release, two months after the previous one. 

Before I get to the changelog, some special notes:

- From this release onwards, the old list of supported apps is replaced by the new, crowdsourced [touchHLE app compatibility database](https://appdb.touchhle.org/).
- In case you missed it, the [touchHLE app archive](https://touchhle.org/app-archive/) was recently launched. It only has one app at the moment, but that's hopefully just the start. If you were an indie developer in the early iPhone days, please get in touch!
- If you want to get notified about future releases, you might want to join the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/sVMXc8z3eS). You can't post there, but you'll be @'d with updates. There's also a [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@touchHLE) where I post short gameplay videos with new releases.
- If you want to help me keep working on this full time, please consider [supporting me financially](https://liberapay.com/hikari_no_yume).

Finally, a big thanks to all the other contributors who made this release what it was! If it weren't for them, there might not have been any new game support in this release.

Happy Hallowee

Thank you all for your continued patience and support. I hope you enjoy!

releases.name: ScummVM 2026.1.0: "Like a version"
releases.body:
Another year has gone by, therefore we are releasing a new ScummVM version. As you may notice right away, we are changing our version numbering schema, but that’s not all! We are also planning on more frequent releases!, which you can read about on [sev’s blog](https://www.patreon.com/posts/new-milestone-in-149535385).

This could be the biggest release we have made so far in terms of the added features and engines. If I count correctly, we have added 12 new engines to our compatibility page. Not games, engines. emulators.latest_body:
Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays and a Happy New Year everyone!

This update adds experimental Online Multiplayer to NetherSX2 along with the usual updates!
Thanks to [IamLupo](https://github.com/IamLupo) for adding it to ARMSX2, and [zakilj3](https://www.youtube.com/user/zakilj3) for discovering the same settings work with NetherSX2!

[VirusTotal Scan Report](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/2029e30dcc1ba1ecb8d73313f18b429b40e6044c7785c52af08b948ef94b3ddf)

## How to use Online Multiplayer
1. Go to your App Settings --> Settings and toggle on Enable DEV9 Ethernet

releases.name: v2.5: DCNet, new on-screen gamepad, DreamConn+ and DreamPicoPort adapters
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* DCNet: a free dedicated VPN service for Dreamcast games that only needs a basic Internet connection. 30 game servers are already available and more are coming.
* Improved on-screen gamepad for Android and iOS: move and resize controls, custom designs, arcade-specific layout, unused controls hidden based on game (arcade) or device (console games).
* Support for physical Dreamcast controllers with DreamConn+ and DreamPicoPort adapters: gamepad, VMU, vibration pack and more.
* New Dreamcast "Full Controller" with 2 analog axes and all possible buttons (Panther DC controller).
* Better analog axis emulation when using a keyboard or digital buttons by using a ramp up/down curve.
* Hardware CD/DVD/BD-ROM support
* GD-ROM arcade games load time reduced to zero.
* Improved GD-ROM access time, particularly with HLE BIOS.
* Fixed: Vulkan per-pixel mode on Mali GPUs.
* Work-around an OpenGLES bug in many drivers displaying the game screen upside down.
* Per-game VMU now compatible with multidisk games.
* Support for some encrypted cheats.
* Online support for Hundred Swords, PBA Bowling, StarLancer and The Next Tetris.

emulators.name: ARMSX2
emulators.description: ARMSX2 - The Playstation 2 Emulator for ARM64 Platforms
emulators.latest_body: # ARMSX2 2.9.2 What's new: **Report a problem.** Found in the library menu, the side drawer and every game's pause menu. Pick what went wrong, add a few words if you like, and see every file and its size before anything is sent. From a game's pause menu the report can carry a save state and a one-frame graphics dump, so we can see the exact scene. You get a report code to paste into Discord or GitHub. Uploads keep going in the background, wait for Wi-Fi when a report is large, and can be stopped and retried. My reports in Settings > App keeps your codes and how each one went. Reports are kept for 90 days and used only to fix bugs. Memory cards, BIOS files and games are never sent, and your RetroAchievements name, network addresses and file paths are taken out of the logs. If ARMSX2 closes unexpectedly while you're using it, it offers to send a crash report the next time it opens, and the GS dump option can start a report with the dump attached. done by @bmdhacks

releases.name: ARMSX2 nightly 20261106 (afd93842f9)
releases.body:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)

Coming from an old nightly? Nightlies are now a separate app, ARMSX2 Nightly, next to stable.

- Android: stable cannot install over an old nightly. Back up your saves and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install the stable APK.
- iOS: your old nightly is the ARMSX2 iOS app and still has your saves. Copy them into ARMSX2 Nightly

## Security: Steam token redaction in logs

GameHub Lite 5.1.8 fixes a logging issue where Steam authentication-related values could appear in diagnostic logs. 
In some cases, logs could include fields such as `steamToken`, `refreshToken`, or `accessToken` from Steam login/launch flows.

**Publicly posted logs containing these fields should be deleted or redacted.**

### IMPORTANT

This should go without saying but If you find any security issues, please reach out **PRIVATELY**. 
I have not checked if this issue is still present in recent GameHub versions, already ruined my one day off I was spending with my family by the person who reported this publicly and I do not plan on spending any more time on this.

### Changelog

The fix adds centralized log redaction for Steam/auth token fields, Steam QR login URLs, JWT-like token strings, and launch command token arguments before logs are written. This covers the app loggers, JavaSteam logging, and the PC launch-log file writer.

This release also pins local patch builds to `apktool 2.12.1`

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite/compare/v5.1.7...v5.1.8

releases.name: GameHub Lite v5.1.6
releases.body:
# GameHub Lite v5.1.6

This release fixes an actual app-side launch issue, and yes, also exists because apparently backend fixes do not count unless there is a fresh APK attached to a GitHub release.

The main app fix is for devices where GameHub would silently refuse to launch games when the `getUnknownDevices` / `startType` API path returned a `404`. Instead of failing closed and doing absolutely nothing, the app now falls back like it already did for the no-internet path.

Confirmed affected and fixed:

- AYANEO Pocket FIT
- Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 / Adreno 750
- Android 14

### Backend changes

More work happened in [gamehub-lite-api](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite-api), because that is where a lot of compatibility and component delivery work lives now.

Backend changes since the `v5.1.5` release include:

- Updated simulator response timestamps so stale responses get refreshed.
- Added release asset verification and MD5 checks for GitHub release assets.
- Updated component manifests, timestamps, deprecated component removal, and total counts.
- Cleaned up SteamAgent2 manifest naming.
- Removed drivers that were already added in the latest GameHub manifest.
- Added ass

releases.name: GameHub Lite v5.1.5
releases.body:
This release is mainly here to make the backend work visible and add the addition off Japanese app translations, thank you @reindex-ot for your contribution!

Most of the recent fixes and updates happened server-side in the GameHub Lite backend, so existing installs already benefited without needing a new APK. Apparently that makes it look like nothing happened, so here is an app release too. I will make a useless release every time we improve something that gets served via the server. 

### Backend changes

The main work happened in:

- [gamehub-lite-api](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite-api)
- [gamehub-lite-worker](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite-worker)

Recent backend-side work includes updated component manifests, new/updated container components, imagefs updates, corrected component counts, proxy/URL updates, and fixes around component list handling.

In particular, the worker/API side is where most compatibility and content fixes now happen. If something starts working without an APK update, that is why.

### App changes

- Update apktool to 2.12.1

- A false-positive report has been filed with Microsoft for the v2.0.0 files; if your antivirus quarantined the runtime, restore it or re-download this release

releases.body:
Use the new v2.0.2 release for critical fixes.

v2.0.0 release of Skate 3 Recomp for Windows, Linux, and macOS (ARM / Experimental).

Skate 3 now renders natively. This release replaces the emulated Xbox 360 GPU with a new renderer built directly on Direct3D 12 and Vulkan: more than double the frame rate at around a quarter of the GPU power draw, and on macOS a jump from roughly 25 FPS to 250 FPS at 4K. The entire game renders natively at close visual parity with the console output, with a set of optional modern graphics enhancements that seek to go beyond it.

The new native renderer is early and is likely to have issues, I haven't tested the game all the way through.

## Downloads

releases.name: DOSBox Pure 1.0 Preview 6
releases.body:
This is the sixth preview release of version 1.0 of DOSBox Pure.

A smaller update with additions and fixes. Again, please test this release and provide feedback as we work towards a release we can call 1.0. Feedback is welcome here on GitHub as well as on [Discord](https://discord.gg/swhZC8xFJw).

## New Features

### Support for Dynamic VHD Disk Images (#694)
Installing an operating system will also automatically create dynamic VHD files from now on (which initially is just a few megabytes and grows as needed)

### Volume Settings (93cf48b)
Volume settings were added to the core options for the various DOS devices (Sound Blaster, Adlib, MIDI, etc.)]

### Handle shut down requests in Windows 9x (#738)
Minimal implementation of APM (Advanced Power Management) BIOS functionality just to handle the power off request by Windows 9x. This will allow to automatically go back to the menu or exit the core/emulator when the emulated Windows is shut down.

## Minor Additions
- Allow mounting of ZIP files via IMGMOUNT command (with `IMGMOUNT X: file.zip -t zip`) (04a1b95)
- Support a custom extended M3U format tag to overlay the multiple contents (i.e. load multiple ZIP files as C:) (#731)

A small update with a few fixes. Again, please test this release and provide feedback as we work towards a release we can call 1.0. Feedback is welcome here on GitHub as well as on [Discord](https://discord.gg/NY52DcUFgK).

## Changes
- Add mode "On (Only On-Screen Keyboard While in Game)" to "Use L3 Button to Show Menu" core input option (#715)

### Network
- **System link over your network** — Settings → Network → System link → LAN: hakuX devices on the same Wi-Fi network find each other as Xbox consoles on a LAN do. releases.body:
GPUs beyond Adreno (experimental).

### GPUs
- **Mali, Xclipse and PowerVR (experimental)** — hakuX runs on GPUs other than Adreno: features they lack are replaced (BC and 4444 textures decoded up front, standard border colours, the push block in a buffer, D32S8 depth), and known driver bugs are worked around (`hw/xbox/hle/vk/quirks.c`). Burnout 3 and Mercenaries run cleanly on a Pixel 8 (Mali-G715)
- **Vulkan 1.1 drivers** — GPUs whose drivers stop at Vulkan 1.1 (Valhall Mali on older or vendor-capped drivers, Qualcomm's own older drivers, early Xclipse, PowerVR BXM) run through a compatibility layer (`hw/xbox/hle/vk/compat.c`)
- **Older GPUs without descriptor indexing (experimental)** — Bifrost Mali (G71, G72, G76, G52) and PowerVR Rogue: each draw binds its own textures, and depth is clamped in the shader where the GPU can't
- **Adreno** — unchanged: every replacement is off where the GPU has the feature.

### App
- **GPU driver** — a screen of its own (Settings → GPU driver): the system driver and the stored packages in one list, with their versions and authors. Packages are checked when added and can be deleted (deleting the one in use goes back to the system driver)
- **Turn

releases.name: hakuX 1.0.0
releases.body:
A new core replaces xemu's QEMU-based one.

### New core
- **CPU** — the Xbox's x86 code runs on a FEX JIT (FEXCore fork), and the Xbox kernel is reimplemented natively (`native/kernel`): no QEMU
- **GPU** — the NV2A push buffer is decoded into Vulkan (HLE, `hw/xbox/hle`). Custom drivers (Turnip) load through adrenotools; driver-specific workarounds are quirks (`hw/xbox/hle/vk/quirks.c`, `debug.hakux.quirks`)
- **Audio** — the MCPX APU runs on the core's own services (`native/dev/apu`), out through AAudio
- **Savestates** — per game, in slots, with the hard disk's files
- **Mods and cheats** — per game, from `mods/` (library long-press "Mods & cheats"): XBE patches and replaced disc files; 60 and 120 fps mods for 13 games (`mods/README.md`, generators in `tools/mods`)
- **Controllers** — each physical controller routed to a player with its own mapping; the on-screen controller adds to player 1

### New features
- **Updates** — hakuX looks for a newer release on GitHub when it starts and on demand (Settings → Updates); one found shows its notes and installs from there
- **Frontends** — a game launched from ES-DE or another frontend returns to it when it closes

This release brings a large collection of game compatibility and graphics fixes, more flexible controls, audio improvements, and easier management of save states and DSi configurations. This release includes a new name, a refreshed visual identity, a much improved interface, RetroArch

releases.name: melonDualDS 0.7.0 RC5: RetroAchievements Stability Update!
releases.body: # Next release will be WatermelonDS! This release is focused on RetroAchievements stability, Hardcore achievement reliability, leaderboards, and new offline achievement provider options. This will also be the last release using the current **melonDualDS** name. The next release will introduce a new interface, a new icon, and a new experimental Vulkan feature called **FastPath**. FastPath is designed to significantly improve performance at high internal resolutions, even up to 8x in some cases. However, FastPath will be experimental. If you want the most stable and accurate experience, closer to real Nintendo DS behavior, it is recommended to keep FastPath disabled when it becomes available. It will be especially useful for devices with slightly weaker chipsets, or for users who want to get the most performance and battery efficiency possible. For RC5, the focus is not Vulkan, UI changes, or general emulator fixes. This release is mainly about making RetroAchievements more stable, more reliable, and more flexible.

releases.name: melonDualDS v0.7.0.rc4: Final Release Candidate, Vulkan Stability, RetroAchievements Fixes, Custom Adreno Drivers, and DSiWare Improvements
releases.body:
# melonDualDS v0.7.0.rc4 is now available.

This is the biggest 0.7.0 release candidate so far.

RC4 focuses on fixing the remaining major Vulkan renderer issues, stabilizing RetroAchievements, improving DSi / DSiWare support, and adding custom Adreno Vulkan driver support through AdrenoTools.

This release fixes the major reported RetroAchievements problems, including offline unlock syncing, Softcore caching, leaderboard tracking, challenge state reliability, pending ledgers, and stale ROM configuration issues.

It also fixes most of the remaining reported Vulkan rendering problems across several games, including Super Mario 64 DS, Etrian Odyssey, Picross 3D, Soma Bringer, Plants vs. Zombies, Mario Kart DS, New Super Mario Bros., Sonic Rush, and Disgaea DS.

If no major regressions are found in this RC, this build will become the final melonDualDS 0.7.0 release.

---

## What changed

### Metroid Prime Remastered graphics
- The arm cannon, suit arm and grapple arm use Remastered's own Thermal and X-Ray Visor models.
- The Chozo Ghosts, Oculus and other enemies use their Remastered X-Ray models.
- The sky no longer looks pale in the X-Ray Visor.
- More of the room models match their Remastered versions.

### Cheats (#264)
- Moon jump.
- Boost Ball speed and duration sliders. You can boost in the air and steer while boosting. (Be careful with high values!!!)
- "Move Samus here" moves Samus to the free camera.

### Difficulty
- Sliders for damage taken and damage dealt, from x0.1 to x10 (F1 > Game > Difficulty).

### Other changes
- Fewer shader pipelines to compile.
- The texture replacement cache shrinks when memory runs low (#266).

- Seamless item pickups (option, off by default and in the Original experience): no control lock or item cutscene, and the item's message shows as a HUD memo instead of pausing.

- Map rotate and pan bindings, with matching button prompts on the map screen. Keys like WASD can pan the map without moving the C-stick in play.
- Touch: a touch on the map or a pointer menu brings back the hidden back and cog buttons.
- Android: the touch editor lists custom actions added after it first opened.

### Reticles
- Trilogy's GameCube crosshair follows the Crosshair size setting again (#255).
- Trilogy's next-target and lock arrows no longer shake or trail behind what they mark.

### Metroid Prime Remastered graphics
- Many more Remastered particle features: child systems per particle, swoosh variables, spline and ring setting

settings in the launcher. Releases now use major.minor.patch numbering.

releases.body:
# suyu v0.0.13

Faster Vulkan pipeline setup, smaller game exports that run from your own game
file, a new optional portable export type, and clearer key and firmware setup.

## Faster Vulkan pipeline setup

On supported Vulkan drivers, suyu now reuses compiled graphics pipeline parts and links a
new pipeline quickly when it is first needed. This reduces long waits caused by graphics
pipeline creation. Suyu builds a fully optimized version in the background after the
first use.

The change is enabled only when the driver reports fast graphics pipeline library
support. Other devices keep the previous path automatically; this includes the tested
macOS MoltenVK build. Android also keeps the previous path by default. If a supported
driver has a rendering problem, turn off **Use graphics pipeline libraries** in the
Vulkan settings.

This improves pipeline waits; loading transitions can still pause for other reasons.

## Game exports run from your game file

Exports no longer copy the game's files. An export records the game file you
selected and opens it at every launch with the keys installed in suyu, the same
way suyu itself plays it. A JIT export is now tens of megabytes instead of t

releases.name: suyu v0.0.12
releases.body:
# suyu v0.0.12

Hybrid exports can now complete the final Windows link and return safely to JIT
when generated code changes. The Windows download includes a matched build kit,
and standalone games include their matching Control metadata.

Portable exports configure their host build for Release and normalize Windows
paths. Windows release builds use the VS 2022 toolset baseline. The kit records
its producer compiler version and rejects an older toolchain with an upgrade
message before compilation.

## Hybrid exports that build and launch reliably

Hybrid exports now recover when a generated module fails compilation or exceeds
Windows executable size limits: the affected module uses Dynamic JIT while the
remaining native modules stay compiled. The export still fails if it cannot
produce the genuine Hybrid executable. Strict Static AOT retains strict failure
behavior.

When a game changes translated code, Hybrid returns to JIT before executing stale
instructions. This fixes the early TOTK guard abort. **Re-export existing games**
to regenerate their code and executable; updating suyu alone does not repair an
older standalone package.

Generated C is packed into translation units cappe

# X360 Mobile 0.6.4 — Hotfix 2

This update brings general correctness, graphics, stability and efficiency improvements, developed and evaluated using **Split/Second** as a reference game. These are improvements to the emulator itself rather than fixes restricted to one title. Other games may also benefit, but broader compatibility and performance testing is still limited.

## Improvements

- Improved handling of demanding graphics workloads and reduced avoidable processing overhead.
- Corrected visual consistency and resource-handling issues, including an issue affecting frame interpolation.
- Improved the reliability of the touch-control layout editor.
- Added optional independent auto-hide for the Menu button.
- Reorganized Settings with fewer main categories and clearer access to game content, patches and advanced tools.

## Split/Second: still experimental

On the tested **Snapdragon 8 Gen 2** setup, Split/Second currently fluctuates around **8–18 FPS**, depending on the scene and the selected experimental settings. The game **still requires extensive further work to become playable on this SoC**. Occasional pauses and remaining graphical issues are still under investigation.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.2 Public Hotfix 1
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.2 Public Hotfix 1

This maintenance release hardens the Vulkan and Android runtime introduced in
0.6.2. It keeps the same public feature line and concentrates on conservative
driver compatibility, reusable caches, memory stability and correct platform
scheduling.

## Vulkan compatibility and cache stability

- Added `vulkan_extended_dynamic_state=auto|static|dynamic` globally and per
  game. `auto` uses the faster Vulkan 1.3 path on capable Qualcomm and Mesa
  drivers, while proprietary Mali and Samsung/Xclipse drivers retain the
  established static path until their exact GPU and driver combination has
  been physically validated.
- Explicit `dynamic` mode still falls back safely when the complete required
  Vulkan functionality is unavailable. PanVK and other Mesa drivers are not
  confused with proprietary drivers from the same GPU vendor.
- Host pipeline descriptions are now isolated between static and dynamic
  modes. Vulkan binary caches are additionally separated by the driver's
  pipeline-cache identity and version, preventing incompatible data from being
  reused after a driver, mode or application update.
- Pipeline-cache writes are atomic and periodical

releases.name: openMSX 21.0
releases.body:
openMSX 21.0 has many improvements on the new GUI introduced in openMSX 20.0 (especially the debugger) and several other smaller features. It also introduces the "setups" concept, which enables you to define an MSX setup (e.g. a Philips VG 8020 with an external disk drive and a joystick, data recorder and printer connected). These can be created, loaded, and automatically started. They can also be saved automatically when you exit.

Furthermore, flash chip emulation has become a lot more accurate, thanks to Laurens Holst.

releases.name: openMSX 20.0
releases.body:
openMSX 20.0—Autumn Spring—is a major release, in which we introduce the new Graphical User Interface, replacing the OSD menu. A faster and more powerful debugger is now included in openMSX itself. Configuration for MSX joystick/JoyMega has been improved drastically using the new GUI. If you still want to use Catapult, you can use the Catapult release that came with openMSX 19.0. Please [read the release notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openMSX/openMSX/RELEASE_20_0/doc/release-notes.txt) for details of the openMSX changes.

As always, special thanks to all the contributors of this release who are not in the core team! Keep these pull requests coming!

Please note that as of now, a system with OpenGL 2 support is required to run openMSX.

releases.name: openMSX 19.1
releases.body:
openMSX 19.1—Reflection—is a bug fix release for openMSX 19.0, as we found some rather nasty issues after releasing, mostly that LaserDisc support was broken. No new Catapult will be released, as it has no changes.  Please [read the release notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openMSX/openMSX/RELEASE_19_1/doc/release-notes.txt) for details of the openMSX changes.

Thanks for those who gave us the feedback so that we found out about these issues.

Please note that this will be the last openMSX release that supports systems without OpenGL 2 or higher.

emulators.latest_body:
# YukiHub v0.4 更新日志

> 本次更新聚焦：**刮削源升级 · FVP 引擎画质与音频修复 · 内置文件提取 · 社区收藏集**

## ✨ 全新功能

- **内置文件提取器**：现在可以直接从 MT 管理器等文件工具访问 YukiHub 的内部文件夹。
- **游戏库支持隐藏游戏**：新增「隐藏」分类，可以把不想出现在主列表里的游戏藏起来，需要时再恢复。
- **大屏模式新增回首页按钮**：右上角可直接退出大屏模式回到首页；原设置按钮同步改为图案化设计，并增加点击动效。
- **Yuki社区新增收藏集功能**（萌萌点回收计划二期）。

## 🎨 体验优化

- **默认刮削源更换为 NextMoe**：相比 VNDB 数据更完整、匹配更准。
- **好友列表排序优化**：改为按最后上线时间排序，且**有未读消息的好友优先排在前面**。
- **KRKR 新增内部存储启动**（实验性）：部分游戏可能受益，目前效果有限，暂时保留。

## 🛠 问题修复

### FVP 引擎

- **同步上游源码修复**：修复部分贴图 bug；场景跳转开始带有转场效果。
- **修复《樱花萌放》Steam 官中版部分文本乱码**：已从引擎侧完成编码映射修复。
- **修复转场黑屏**：等待上游修复的转场黑屏问题已随本次同步解决。
- **修复《はっぴぃ☆マーガレット!》汉化问题**。
- **修复对话框背景白色不透明**：对话框背景现在会正确显示为半透明，且设置里的「窗口颜色」R/G/B/A 滑条**可实时生效**。
- **修复游戏爆音**：修正了音量与声道的单位换算错误，响度不再溢出削波。

## 📌 说明

- **隐藏游戏**：隐藏后的游戏会移入「隐藏」分类，可在该分类中随时恢复显示。
- **KRKR 内部存储启动**：属实验性功能，效果因游戏而异，如遇异常可改回原启动方式。
- **FVP 引擎更新仅涉及引擎侧**：不改变存档格式，原有存档可正常读取。

---

感谢每一位玩家的反馈与支持，祝游玩愉快！🎮

releases.body:
# YukiHub v0.3.5 更新日志

> 本次更新聚焦：**新引擎支持 · 大屏体验 · 社区互动 · 在线状态 · 稳定性修复**

## ✨ 全新功能

- **新增 PC 引擎**：支持兼容 **Winlator-CN** 快捷启动。使用方法：手动选择 PC 引擎 → 添加游戏文件夹 → 选择 exe 文件启动即可。（请确保已安装 **Winlator-CN 1005 或更新版本**）
- **新增 FVP 引擎兼容启动**：FVP 引擎正式可用。
- **大屏模式新增搜索功能**：位于分类栏最上方，支持按游戏名与会社名搜索。
- **社区接入 NextMoe 贴纸表情包**：现在可以更愉快地带表情包发言了（bushi）。
- **在线状态区分手机 / 电脑端**：在线标记已区别化显示，为 PC 端接入做好准备。

## 🎨 体验优化

- **FVP 引擎新增虚拟鼠标按钮**：复用 KRKR / Artemis 的虚拟鼠标方案，操作更顺手。

## 🛠 问题修复

- **修复扫描入库的游戏固定使用 VNDB 源的问题**：扫描入库后现在会按设置中选择的资料源进行匹配，与手动添加保持一致。
- **修复大屏模式游玩时长不计入网页端每日任务的问题**：大屏游玩现在会正常上报服务端，经验与每日任务均可正常结算。
- **修复设置面板上下滑动时选项被误判为点击、导致界面被"硬控"的问题**。
- **修复 FVP 引擎视频播放问题**：需手动将原游戏视频转换为标准 MP4 格式 —— 编码 **H.264 (AVC)**、音频 **AAC**；720p 推荐 4000 比特率，1080p 推荐 6000 比特率。
- **移除 Bangumi 镜像源**：因镜像源频繁失效，已正式下线；此前使用镜像源的用户升级后将**自动切换为 Bangumi 官源**（官源访问可能需要一点 🔮）。

## 📌 说明

- 网络类静默失败已补充日志记录，开启日志后更便于排查问题。
- 以上修复均不涉及引擎存档镜像逻辑，原有存档数据不受影响。

---

感谢每一位玩家的反馈与支持，祝游玩愉快！🎮

releases.name: YukiHub v0.3
releases.body:
# YukiHub v0.3 更新简介

> 本次更新聚焦：**UI 全面焕新 · 大屏模式 · 展厅功能 · 资讯与正版导购 · 账号体验 · 大量稳定性修复**

## ✨ 全新功能

- **大屏模式（主打）**：全新大屏播放体验，支持在大屏上畅享游戏 PV；新增从**文件夹**选取视频的来源（部分设备受系统限制无法从相册正常浏览图集，只能按时间一个个翻，很麻烦，现已绕开）。
- **首页接入 Gal 资讯**：打开 App 即可浏览最新 Galgame 动态。
- **正式接入 NextMoe 数据源**：账号快捷登录同步迁移为 **NextMoe·未萌** 快捷登录；聊天室支持 NextMoe 表情包。
- **游戏库正版导购**：网页社区游戏库新增游戏详情页，接入 **DLsite 正版链接** 与 **Steam 正版链接**（通过 Steam API 显示实时价格）。接入 NextMoe 分销链接，流量好的话后续会在社区发放 DL 正版游戏优惠券。
- **忘记密码 / 找回密码**：支持自助找回账号。
- **游戏时长编辑**：支持手动编辑游戏时长记录。
- **展厅玩法扩展**：3D 游戏展厅与多人在线展厅持续建设中，本版本新增音乐间（离线展厅可播放玩家自行导入的游戏专辑音乐），并支持共同观影等多人互动玩法。
- **多人在线展厅（重磅）**：全新网页端多人 3D 展厅上线！和朋友一起在线逛街、聊天、互动，包含：
  - 影院：共同观影、点播排队、投票换片、管理员管理（强制播放/跳片、远程灯光等）；
  - 音乐间：播放玩家自行导入的游戏专辑音乐，附赠一台古典音乐播放机；
  - 钓鱼等小游戏与更多互动玩法；
  - 离线展厅同步升级音乐间。
- **3D 游戏展厅**：以"逛博物馆"的仪式感重新设计，游戏以实体盒子陈列在虚拟 3D 房间中。

## 🎨 体验优化

- **UI 全面焕新**：整体视觉语言与配色体系全面重设计，界面更现代、更统一，观感焕然一新。
- 注册 / 登录页交互逻辑全面优化。
- 首页、游戏库按钮样式与配色统一化，UI 细节全面打磨。
- 手柄适配继续完善。
- 融合 GalToolbox 能力。
- 软件内更新默认源切换至 **GitCode**。
- 鲲 Gal 域名变更同步。

## 🛠 问题修复

- 修复好友列表"离线用户仍显示正在游玩"的 bug（根因为游戏时长未成功回传形成记录闭环）。
- 修复聊天室图片只缓存一半的问题。
- 修复验证码无动画反馈的问题。
- 修复共存版无法扫描添加文件的问题（初始库默认缺失生成项）。
- 修复游戏时长相关的若干功能 bug。
- ONS 游戏：视频播放改为**长按 2 秒跳过**（原为点击跳过，避免误触）。

## 📌 说明

- **PC 端同步**：PC 端版

releases.name: Winlator 7.1.2 with Native Glibc
releases.body:
#### Added
- Added support for `Box64rc`, allowing different Box64 parameters to be set for each process.
- Added `virtual touchscreen` support, also referred to as `direct cursor` support. True touchscreen support requires implementing the XInput2 extension.
- Added support for Chinese. And any corrections to the translation are welcome.
- Added an `content manager`, allowing you to install Wine, graphics drivers, or DX wrappers externally.
- Added the ability to reinstall system files, allowing recovery even if the system files are accidentally damaged.
- Added more VKD3D feature level options.
- Added android `file provider` feature, allowing access to the Winlator data directory through the file manager.
- Added the ability to add `shortcuts` to the home screen, allowing you to launch your programs directly from the desktop. Shortcut changes will be synced in real-time.

#### Fixed
- Fixed the crash issue that occurred when running programs with long Japanese or Chinese titles.
- Corrected the button styling in the DXVK configuration dialog.
- Fixed certain abnormal issues on some SoCs (such as 870), by compiling Box64 with the `BAD_SIGNAL` parameter enabled.
- Fixed an issue t

releases.name: Winlator 7.1.1 with Native Glibc
releases.body:
#### Added
- Added `dxvk-2.4` and `dxvk-gplasync-2.4`, and set dxvk-2.3.1 as the default dxvk. 
- Added version switching and configuration support for `vkd3d`.
- Added `vkd3d-2.13`.
- Added an older version of `box64` (`box64-2.8`).
- Added support for linear triggers. (currently only for Xinput)

#### Fixed
- Fixed the path for the dxvk configuration file.
- Fixed the path for the Virgl server; `VirGL` is now working.
- Fixed keyboard input issues for some games.

#### Changed
- The `AVX` extension for box64 is **disabled** by default. It needs to be manually enabled by creating a new `box64 preset` in the settings.
- Enabled all cores by default for experimental wow64.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/longjunyu2/winlator/compare/v7.1.0...v7.1.1

**Note**: Please uninstall previous versions before installation to avoid potential errors. Remember to **back up** your data.

releases.body:
# Winlator Mali Bionic 1.2.1

A fixes-and-polish update to 1.2.

## ⚠️ Reinstall Required!
Uninstall the old version and install 1.2.1 fresh. Back up your game saves first (Save Manager, or copy them out of your container). Containers made on 1.2 are not carried over.

## Fixes for 1.2 user reports
- Fixed a reboot on some MediaTek Mali phones (JM Mali).
- Fixed a crash when opening a shortcut.
- Fixed the controller binding editor.
- Fixed the stutter when holding D-pad right.
- Fixed File Manager not opening (it needed `libcdio.dll`), and File Manager hanging on x86_64 Wine (replaced with Bannerlator's newer `wfm.exe` / `winhandler.exe`).

## Graphics and performance
- **Fullscreen modes:** Fit, Stretch, Fill and Integer, plus screen alignment (Center, Top, Bottom half), set per container or per game and changeable live in Display & Session.
- **EGL stripes fixed:** CPU writes into the window buffer are flushed per X batch.
- **ZeroFG:** the default multiplier is capped at the display refresh rate (40 fps on a 60 Hz screen now gives 1.5x instead of 2x with dropped frames).
- **Gladio:** refuses OpenGL contexts above 3.3 again; libGL stripped of debug info (1.48 MB to 488 KB).

Winlator Mali Bionic v1.2 Winlator Mali Bionic v1.2 is a major architectural overhaul over v1.1, introducing a native EGL rendering engine, ZeroFG Vulkan compute frame interpolation, a redesigned UI with Madeira Liquid Glass touch controls, two selectable BCn layers, hardware performance tools, kernel-direct telemetry, and a cloud-powered community configuration ecosystem. ⚠️ Reinstall Required!
🖥️ Native EGL Rendering Engine & Gladio Integration

  • Elimination of Legacy Overhead: Removed the legacy DisplayX layer (displayx.cpp, DisplayXView), VirGL (VirGLRendererComponent), and blit_converter.cpp, eliminating over 3,500 lines of redundant CPU blit and synchronization code.
  • Gladio Native OpenGL Engine: In

releases.name: Winlator Mali Bionic 1.1
releases.body:
Winlator Mali Bionic v1.1

🚀 New Features

- Added Fake HDR.
- Added a Universal FPS Limiter.
- Added a Sharpness option.
- Added GTA V Optimization toggle in Shortcut Settings.
- Added DXVK Config toggle with built-in pre-made configuration presets.
- Automatically generates a dxvk.conf file for each container based on the selected preset.
- Added new DXVK versions.
- Added the new GameNative Vulkan Wrapper.
- Added new Box64 and FEX presets.

---

🎮 Unreal Engine 3 Preset

- Added a dedicated Unreal Engine 3 preset.
- Tested with X-Men Origins: Wolverine for improved compatibility and performance.

---

⚙️ Hybrid x86 FEXCore

- Added a custom Hybrid x86 FEXCore.

What does it do?

- Improves compatibility while maintaining high performance.
- Fixes physics issues in supported games that normally require x86 Reduced Precision to be completely disabled.

Why is it better?

Normally, disabling x86 Reduced Precision forces software emulation for all x86 code, which can significantly reduce performance.

Hybrid x86 only uses software emulation where it is actually needed (such as physics calculations), while allowing the rest of the game to run natively for much better performance.

releases.name: Winlator Mali Bionic 1.0 ( Updated Again )
releases.body:
Winlator Mali Bionic v1.0

New Features

- Multiple Vulkan Wrapper Selection — Select between Wrapper, Wrapper-Leegao, and Wrapper V2 on a per-container basis.
- ASTC Transcoding — Native ASTC texture transcoding using a modified version of leegao's bcn_layer with improved performance, memory usage, and stability.
- ETC2 Transcoding — Native ETC2 texture transcoding using a modified version of leegao's bcn_layer with improved performance, memory usage, and stability.
- Apex Frame Generation — Based on Motion Compute Frame Interpolator (MCFI), with additional implementation and optimizations for improved performance, stability, and compatibility. Apex also utilizes GPU resources alongside the game and may impact performance depending on your device.
- Advanced HUD — Enhanced in-game overlay based on Winlator Ludashi's HUD with additional refinements.
- Unified Control System — XInput, DInput, and Exclusive input modes have been unified into a single control system.
- Graphics Driver Manager — Install and manage Vulkan Wrappers and bcn_layer directly from local storage. User-installed drivers automatically take priority over bundled versions.
- Gyro View — Control the in-game camera

**Beta 28.** Menos quedas com as runas e a câmera do Slate, o giroscópio como a tela do Switch e a memória compartilhada tentando outro caminho no Xclipse.

## Novidades

- **Movimento do celular como a tela do Switch** (Menu > Controles; #211, #247): com a opção ligada, girar e inclinar o celular funcionam como no Switch no modo portátil. Experimente se, ao inclinar o celular, a mira gira, e ao girar, ela inclina. Os controles com giroscópio ficam como antes.
- **Memória do jogo por arquivo compartilhado (experimental):**
  - Quando o driver não oferece memória que a CPU consiga usar pelo caminho normal, o app agora tenta um dma-buf (#234, Xclipse).
  - O log diz por que a opção não foi usada (por exemplo, o driver não exporta memória) e quais formas de exportação o driver tem (#249).
  - **Se você tem Mali ou Xclipse, teste e mande o log:** Configurações > Compatibilidade do driver.

## Correções

releases.body:
Hello everyone. I'm writing this to inform all of you on the current status of star, and what it will be and if its actually getting continued.

Star will be continued, yes, but also no. It's going to be a fresh new start, because everything was ruined because of my actions and how I acted with the project, along with the team members. - The star development continues! (now under WinHub)
- The focus on next release will be mostly Quality of Life features. This means fixing long standing bugs, but more importantly, adding a lot of new features.
- The Vegas implementation will be severely improved with new features, configurations and more.
- The experience will be severely improved. I'll try my best to make it the most user friendly possible.

releases.name: G-Diffuser 1.2.2 - Save and Import Hotfix
releases.body:
## G-Diffuser 1.2.2 - Save and Import Hotfix

- Fix disk-write ownership checks that could prevent Course Edit saves from completing and cause track imports to fail with MFS error 244.
- Preserve snapshot validation, rollback, and recovery protections during save and import operations.
- Add regression coverage using the production disk-write helper, including write failures and rollback.

Back up your installation's save and course-state files before updating. This hotfix does not change the course snapshot format.

releases.name: G-Diffuser 1.2.1 - The Small Improvements and Fixes Update
releases.body:
## Back up before upgrading

Close the game and back up the complete save set (your saves folder), not only the GDD. Keep the GDD, its recovery and snapshot directories, and `course-elements.gdxs`, `course-forks.gbs`, and
`course-settings.gks` together. Do not open snapshot-backed saves in an older executable.
The new, extended tracks that go above the original 64 node limit are not compatible with the original Expansion Kit or older tools.

## Course Edit

- Widen the native course information panel at a fixed size. Keep full 20-character names on
  one row and fit three-digit node counts without moving the buttons below it. Dynamic sizing
  is deferred.

- Raise the combined main-path and alternate-path control-point ceiling to **127**. Geometry,
  jump, effect, decoration, and junction budgets still apply; 127 points is not a guarantee
  that every layout fits.
- Add complete, content-bound save snapshots for extended courses and complete course/cup
  package sharing. Missing or mismatched required snapshot data is rejected rather than
  silently loading a truncated course.
- Keep both paths selectable after editor reload and save/reload. Show stored branch nodes
  without requi

releases.name: G-Diffuser 1.2.0 - The Big Upgrade Edition
releases.body:
1.2.0 brings G-Diffuser to macOS and Android, adds an in-game updater, and is the biggest Course Edit update so far: Mouse Controls, undo, forks, lava strips from F-Zero GX, Magnet strips for the original F-Zero, and Blender-style camera controls. Thanks to everyone in the feature requests channel who shaped it.

## Before you update

- **Coming from 1.1.0, download this release by hand.** 1.1.0 has no updater. From 1.2 on, desktop builds can update themselves.
- **To install by hand,** extract the release over your existing `G-Diffuser` folder. Your `saves/`, ROM and game data stay where they are.
- **Rebuild your ROM hack archives.** Hacks now carry more of their own data, and an archive built by an older version doesn't have it.
- **Continue Cup is per hack.** An existing `gp_resume.bin` stays with the stock game, and each hack starts with no saved cup.
- **Courses that use new features need 1.2.** Forks, magnet traps, custom music and custom elements are ignored or lost on older versions.

## New platforms

- **macOS (Apple Silicon)**, on Metal, for macOS 11 or newer. Tested on an M1. The build isn't signed, so allow the first launch under System Settings > Privacy & Security.

releases.body:
# Open Nectar 1.0.9.1 — Windows antivirus fix

### **Windows only.** 

Linux, macOS and Android stay on
[1.0.9](https://github.com/SSunnKing/Open-Nectar---Pikmin-Native-PC-Mobile-Port/releases/tag/1.0.9).
Download those from there. Nothing changes in the games themselves.

**Updating:** press **Update** in your launcher. Saves, settings and texture
packs carry over.

## Windows Defender flagged the launcher as a trojan

Some players got a "Threat found" warning from Windows Defender for
`nectar-launcher.exe` (`Trojan:Win32/Bearfoos.A!ml`). This was a false
positive. The `!ml` means it came from Defender's machine-learning guess,
not from a real malware match.

The launcher was doing things that look suspicious to an antivirus: it
started `curl.exe` and `tar.exe` in the background to download updates and
texture packs, and the exe had no publisher or version info. This release
changes that:

* Downloads now happen inside the launcher instead of through `curl.exe`.
* Update zips are unpacked inside the launcher instead of through `tar.exe`.
* `nectar.exe`, `nectar-pal.exe` and `nectar-launcher.exe` now have
  publisher and version information (right-click → Properties → Details).

A fix release. Thanks to **BitRanger** for the Quick Save/Load work and the save corruption fix (GitHub pull requests #9 and #10), each tested save by save on a real device.

### Fixed

- **Game saves no longer get corrupted after a Quick Load.** After a Quick Save and Load, a game's own saves could end up with bytes of the previous save at the end, or with their end missing (Hollow Knight reported "Save Corrupted"). The game's own flushes now reach the file. (BitRanger)

## Lemon-Project v1.2.0

### New
- **Lemon FG, Lemon's own frame generation.** Built in, nothing to install, and no Lossless Scaling code in it: turn it on in Settings → Graphics → Frame generation, for all games or one. A new **Engine** option picks Lemon FG (default) or Lossless Scaling, which only runs with your own copy of `Lossless.dll`. The FPS counter shows which one is working, and Lemon FG has its own lemon icon. The setup screen explains that Lemon FG is included instead of only offering to load the DLL.
- **Accurate is the default GPU mode again** in Lemon: the optimizations in this version pay for most of its cost (measured: TOTK 48.1 → 47.9 fps on an AYN Odin 3, BOTW 16.6 → 17.0 fps on a Galaxy S24 Ultra). Lemon Lite and Lemon Lite & Spoofed keep Fast.
- **One lighter wait for the GPU.** Lemon still waits for the GPU before a game reuses what was drawn, so the flickering fixed in 1.1 stays fixed, but it no longer drains the GPU when the game waits for work that is already queued (Garfield: GPU thread stalls from ~156 to ~13 ms per second). ## Lemon-Project v1.1.0

### Three builds
- **Lemon**: the full version, as before.
- **Lemon Lite**: lighter defaults for weaker GPUs (0.75x resolution, asynchronous shaders on), without the bundled Lemon-Ade driver, and experimental PanVK drivers for Mali-G720 and Mali-G52 in the driver downloader (each GPU only sees its own). It installs next to Lemon and can import your keys, firmware, games and saves from it.

The intent is to port this project over to pure SDL3 eventually, but the compatability layer approach allows people to play around with things while waiting for the porting to be completed. This also gives this project a fallback in case SDL2 stops being supported upstream but new functionality such as gamepad support for new game controllers continues to be updated on the SDL3 branch.

emulators.latest_body:
This release adds a bundled driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite, brings back the audio presets that were missing from 0.6.0, fixes DLC imports and GPU hangs, lets each touch control be resized, and redesigns the launcher.

## Graphics

- **Adreno 8xx driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite.** A source-built Mesa 26.3 Turnip with a fix for the newer Qualcomm gralloc, which otherwise leaves the whole image garbled on Adreno 830. Auto selects it on SM8750 devices unless an imported driver is chosen, and it always renders with `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,nobin`. On Adreno 830 it measured about 12 ms of GPU time per frame at 100% resolution, compared with about 26 ms on the stock driver. Other Adreno 8xx GPUs can select it manually; it has only been validated on Adreno 830.
- **High refresh rate displays.** The game requests the display's fastest mode and passes the FPS option to Android, so FPS settings above 60 are no longer capped at 60 by vsync on 120 Hz phones.
- **Fewer frozen images on Adreno 6xx** ([#170](https://github.com/SansNope/UnleashedRecomp-Android/issues/170)). Some Turnip builds return early from an unlimited GPU wait; the game now waits again instead of reusing buffers the GPU is still drawing.

This release adds a bundled driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite, brings back the audio presets that were missing from 0.6.0, fixes DLC imports and GPU hangs, lets each touch control be resized, and redesigns the launcher.

## Graphics

- **Adreno 8xx driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite.** A source-built Mesa 26.3 Turnip with a fix for the newer Qualcomm gralloc, which otherwise leaves the whole image garbled on Adreno 830. Auto selects it on SM8750 devices unless an imported driver is chosen, and it always renders with `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,nobin`. On Adreno 830 it measured about 12 ms of GPU time per frame at 100% resolution, compared with about 26 ms on the stock driver. Other Adreno 8xx GPUs can select it manually; it has only been validated on Adreno 830.
- **High refresh rate displays.** The game requests the display's fastest mode and passes the FPS option to Android, so FPS settings above 60 are no longer capped at 60 by vsync on 120 Hz phones.
- **Fewer frozen images on Adreno 6xx** ([#170](https://github.com/SansNope/UnleashedRecomp-Android/issues/170)). Some Turnip builds return early from an unlimited GPU wait; the game now waits again instead of reusing buffers the GPU is still drawing.

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.6.0
releases.body:
- Fixed DLC imports after the base game is installed, including DLC-only ZIPs/folders and ZIPs left in to_install by older builds (issue #162). Packs are hash-checked in a temporary tree before replacement; previous packs can be recovered after an interrupted replacement.
- Accepted HMM JSON schemas with trailing commas, comments and a UTF-8 BOM; schema errors no longer dump the complete file (issue #93).
- Added a persisted game-storage choice for internal memory, app folders and Android/media folders on mounted volumes, including SD cards. Optional verified copying keeps the original game, mods, settings and saves (issue #90).
- Added missing translations in English, Russian, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese and Portuguese, including mod settings, updates, storage selection and localized file/installer errors.
- Fixed overlapping guest memory copies with `memmove`, addressing the ring crash and broken collision triggers (PR #158 fix by [puopg (Michael Chen)](https://github.com/puopg)).
- Removed the earlier small-block quarantine and collision repair workarounds alongside that fix (PR #158).
- Extended landscape gameplay into the display-cutout area (PR #153 fix by [vla

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.3
releases.body:
small update

### Vulkan driver profiles

- Added **Adreno 8xx Experimental (sysmem+flushall)** as a separate, non-default launcher choice.
- The new profile uses the bundled whitebelyash Mesa 26.2 gen8-capable driver and forces the exact `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,flushall` workaround for artifact-prone Adreno 8xx devices.

### Android audio presets

- Added an experimental **POCO F8 Ultra (low latency)** preset. It reduces the internal FIFO cushion from 16 to 8 guest audio frames (about 85 ms to 43 ms) and requests AAudio's exclusive low-latency path to avoid HyperOS selecting an approximately 80 ms shared hardware burst.
- The existing **Default** and **AYN** behavior is unchanged. The POCO-specific path is opt-in because it may crackle, stall or lose sound on devices whose AAudio/MMAP implementation is unreliable.
- The selected preset, resolved FIFO parameters, AAudio performance/sharing modes, hardware burst, active buffer and platform xrun count are written to the Android log.

releases.body:

Version 0.5.2 replaces the withdrawn 0.5.1 APK. It includes every user-facing change from 0.5.1, removes performance instrumentation that was unintentionally left enabled there, and adds the following.

### Mod settings (issue #75)

- Mods with an HMM `ConfigSchemaFile` now have their own settings button.
- Boolean, string, integer, floating-point and custom-enum fields are supported, including descriptions, defaults and numeric limits.
- Settings are saved atomically to the mod's INI without discarding unrelated sections, keys or comments.

### In-app updates (issue #83)

- Added periodic update checks and a manual **Check for updates** button.
- The launcher shows release notes and download progress, verifies GitHub's SHA-256 digest when present, and rejects APKs with a different package name or Android signing certificate.
- Installation is handed to Android's system installer; game files, saves, mods and settings stay in place.

releases.body:

> This APK has been withdrawn. Install [version 0.5.2](https://github.com/SansNope/UnleashedRecomp-Android/releases/tag/v0.5.2) instead.

Version 0.5.1 unintentionally shipped with always-on GPU performance instrumentation that added per-frame timing-query and logging overhead. Its APK asset was removed to prevent further installations.

This release candidate completes support for the cheat instructions implemented by Eden's DMNT engine and improves cheat-file parsing and process targeting.

**This is a pre-release for testing before v0.1.1.** Feedback and reproducible bug reports are welcome. It includes all improvements from rc1 through rc7.

### What's new since rc7

- **Extended cheat instructions:** implemented register comparisons, register save/restore operations and masks, persistent static registers, process pause/resume, and debug logging, with all operand and addressing forms supported by Eden.
- **Cheat execution:** corrected nested if/else handling, loop decoding, arithmetic behavior, and handling of truncated or unknown instructions. Controller input is sampled once per execution so multiple button conditions see the same input state.
- **Cheat files and process targeting:** fixed parsing of names containing Unicode symbols or accents. Memory operations and pause/resume now target the process identified by the cheat metadata, with a cached non-owning process reference.
- **Regression coverage:** 24 cheat-engine tests pass, covering instruction execution, memory widths, pointer chains, branches, loops

This release candidate fixes several cheat-engine decoding errors, adds missing process-memory service calls, and addresses an applet command that caused some game to abort.

**This is a pre-release for testing before v0.1.1.** Feedback and reproducible bug reports are welcome. It includes all improvements from rc1 through rc6.

### What's new since rc6

- **Cheat execution:** corrected data widths, register selection, immediate values, and pointer-chain offsets. These errors could prevent loaded cheats from taking effect.
- **Process-memory services:** wired `SetProcessMemoryPermission`, `MapProcessMemory`, and `UnmapProcessMemory` into both ARM64 and ARM32 system-call dispatch. Aligned permission handling and validation order with Eden, with tests for writable aliases, unmapping, and error handling. This addresses missing calls needed by injected cheat modules; end-to-end compatibility with third-party CheatVM modules is not yet verified.
- **Applet compatibility:** added Eden's success response for `ILibraryAppletAccessor` command 90. Also implemented `GetLibraryAppletInfo` to return the child applet's identity and mode.
- **Windows interface:** fixed missing checkmark icons on

releases.name: Ruzu v0.1.1-rc6
releases.body:
This release candidate fixes an audio-update parsing error that could cause invalid mixer data and audio glitches.

**This is a pre-release for testing before v0.1.1.** Feedback and reproducible bug reports are welcome. It includes all improvements from rc1 through rc5.

### What’s new since rc5

- **Audio update parsing:** the audio renderer now respects the splitter block size declared in the update header. Previously, it could read the following mixer block at the wrong offset, resulting in invalid mix counts or rejected audio updates.
- **Input validation:** added bounds checks for declared splitter blocks.
- **Regression coverage:** added synthetic tests covering splitter block boundaries, subsequent mixer updates, and header layout.

This correction addresses a likely cause of the audio errors reported in [issue #21](https://github.com/vricosti/ruzu-emu/issues/21). Confirmation through extended gameplay is still needed.

### Known limitations

Unsupported shader instructions may still cause missing graphics or prevent a scene from rendering. This release does not resolve every freeze, black-screen issue, or audio glitch.

Multi-program game compatibility remains experimental.

releases.name: Ruzu v0.1.1-rc5
releases.body:
**This release candidate improves shader error handling, Windows build support, and diagnostics for freezes and black screens.

**This is a pre-release for testing before v0.1.1.** Feedback and reproducible bug reports are welcome. It includes the improvements from rc1 through rc4.

### What’s new since rc4

- **Shader stability:** unsupported shader instructions now produce an error that the Vulkan pipeline compiler can handle, rather than terminating the GPU worker. This improves error recovery but does not add support for those instructions.
- **Graphics compatibility:** aligned constant-buffer and texture validation with Eden and corrected how constant-buffer values are recorded for shader caching.
- **Windows memory handling:** aligned unsupported memory-protection handling with Eden, avoiding an unconditional panic.
- **Windows builds:** improved detection of existing Visual Studio installations and installation of missing C++ tools. Runtime DLLs are now copied alongside the build binaries, and a vcpkg compatibility fix was added.
- **Troubleshooting:** added a PowerShell script to capture diagnostic memory dumps when Ruzu freezes or displays a black screen. It downloads and

releases.name: Ruzu v0.1.1-rc4
releases.body:
This release candidate adds support for multi-program titles such as game collections and fixes an ordering problem in kernel thread termination.

**This is a pre-release for testing before v0.1.1.** Feedback and reproducible bug reports are welcome. It includes the improvements from rc1, rc2 and rc3.

### What’s new since rc3

- **Game collections:** titles that chain into a sub-program (`ExecuteProgram`) now work. Previously, picking a game from a collection’s menu left the screen frozen at 0 FPS. Ruzu now shuts the running program down and boots the requested program of the same file. 
- **Kernel:** thread termination now signals completion and notifies waiting threads under the scheduler lock, after the terminating thread has left its core. This closes an ordering window between the two notifications.

### Known limitations

Only the collection listed above was tested with the new sub-program launch path. Other multi-program titles may still expose missing behavior, and reports are welcome.

**KNOWN ISSUE:** Physical controllers are currently still broken in this build. Directory fixes are working. Recommended for touch-screen users only

Hey everyone, v1.6 is live.

I got a hold of an Android device to test with, which brought a lot of bugs to my immediate attention. I’ve done some work cleaning up the codebase to make this actually usable on devices like the Retroid, Thor, Ayaneo.

Just to be transparent: Since I'm working with Zep on the official iOS release, the Android version is going to remain an unofficial side project. However, I still want it to be a quality experience for those of you using it, so I'm pushing these QoL updates to get it stable.

**The Big Fixes:**

**Android Storage Fixed:** Closed issue #18. The directory picker now actually works. You can point it to your external SD card or any ROM folder, and it won't crash or fail to import. It respects your folder structure and keeps the app data separate.

**Immersive Mode:** Closed issue #19. The Android navigation bar now hides correctly, giving you full-screen real estate for the games. There's also a setting to remove the virtual controls completely for a true full screen mode.

**UI Overhaul:** A

[[IMPORTANT]] Android has been sunsetted until further notice. see [the future of pocket8.](https://www.reddit.com/r/Pocket8/comments/1rerp4t/the_future_of_pocket8_important/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=web3x&utm_name=web3xcss&utm_term=1&utm_content=share_button) One of my biggest updates so far. Pocket8 is now officially running on Android! **New Features:** - **Android Support:** There was a huge demand for this. I'm listening! I don't have an Android device to test on currently, so please leave feedback. - **Multicart Support:** .p8.png Multi-Cart titles are now supported. **Note: .p8 Multi-Cart titles are not.** The current engine is a web-build, and does not usually support .p8 files or multicart titles at all. However, games that use absolute file names when loading carts in their code work fine. An example of a working multicart game is [Golf Monday](https://johanpeitz.itch.io/golf-monday). - **Library Management:** You can now rename and favorite your carts. Long-press to organize your collection.

**Coming Soon:** - *

releases.name: v1.4.1
releases.body:
Dpad corrections and optimizations.

- Fixed cardinal directions being difficult to input. Diagonals were too easy, this has been eased.
- Asymmetric ergonomics - up-left diagonal is easier to hit, its area has been widened to support natural motion of the thumb.
- "Finger Rolling' support added, as to push the face buttons without having to lift first. Suggested by u/Ruvalolowa.
- Auto-save on pause/exit
- blurs on buttons weren't on their own GPU layers, this has been fixed for a big performance increase.
- input mapping was creating massive garbage, this has been fixed.
- implemented silent-buffer to keep the iOS audio thread awake, greatly improving audio latency

Enjoy!

This alpha keeps each game in a folder of its own with everything that belongs to it, gives cheats their own list, adds a speed limit and a second frame generation method, and fixes a lost graphics device and black boxes that spread over the picture. Performance and compatibility still vary by game.

### New and improved

- **One folder per game.** A game can sit in a folder of its own in `roms/`, together with its update and DLC files, its mods (`mods/`), its cheats (`cheats/`) and its own post-processing presets (`reshade/`). ProsperoEden tells the game from its update and DLC by what each file holds, so the files can have any names. **Delete from console** removes the folder's update and DLC too. Games downloaded from a source now go into a folder of their own the same way. Your files stay where they are and keep working. See [Game files folder](https://github.com/blackbearreloaded/ProsperoEden/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md#game-files-folder).
- **Cheats in a list of their own.** A game's settings have a **Cheats** row next to **Mods**: every cheat of the game with its own switch, and an **All cheats** switch apart from the Mods one. **Mods** now lists patches and replacement files

This alpha adds post-processing looks and wallpapers of your own, frees more memory, and makes games with many shaders start and start again faster. Performance and compatibility still vary by game.

- **Post-processing (new setting).** **Settings > Video > Post-processing**, and the same row in a game's own settings, draws a look over the picture with ReShade FX effects: Off, or one of six presets that come with the app (Anime, Cinematic, Clean, Dreamy, Retro, Vivid).
