releases.name: ProsperoEden v1.003.000
releases.body:
This alpha focuses on mod stability, controller support, graphics correctness and lower emulation overhead. Performance and compatibility still vary by game; these changes do not guarantee a particular frame rate.

### Fixes and improvements

- **TOTK + UltraCam startup crash fixed.** Large modded RomFS rebuilds could overflow the filesystem thread stack during cleanup and close the whole app. Cleanup is now iterative. Tested with TOTK **1.1.1** and an older UltraCam mod: the game reached its menu, and the user confirmed the free camera works in gameplay. Game/mod versions still need to match; this is not a claim that every UltraCam version or TOTK update works.
- **Memory size per game.** Choose 4, 6 or 8 GiB of emulated console memory under **Settings > Performance > Memory**, with game-specific overrides for demanding mods. This uses the PS5's existing shared memory pool; it does not add physical RAM. See [Console memory](https://github.com/blackbearreloaded/ProsperoEden/blob/v1.003.000/docs/SETTINGS.md#console-memory).
- **DualSense audio haptics.** HD rumble can use the controller's audio haptics path, with lifecycle and failure handling fixes.
- **Touchpad and controls.** Spl

releases.name: ProsperoEden v1.002.000
releases.body:
- **More free memory for demanding games.** The console's memory is one pool shared by the emulated console, the emulator itself and the graphics, and part of it was held without being used. The emulated console's memory, the code caches and a reserve on the system's side now take memory only when they need it. A large open-world game at 2x has about 3.5 GiB free during play instead of 2.2 GiB, at the same frame rate, so a long session runs out of memory far later.
- **PS5 Pro memory mode.** On a PS5 Pro, ProsperoEden asks for the larger memory pool the console offers: 13.5 GiB instead of 12 GiB. A line at launch (`memory:` in `stderr.log`) says whether it is active. Contributed by [OverkillLabs](https://github.com/OverkillLabs3).
- **"Ran out of graphics memory" less often above 1x.** The part that frees textures no game is using could stop looking before it had freed anything, so graphics memory filled up although much of it could be freed. Contributed by [mzet97](https://github.com/mzet97).
- **Vibration strength (new setting).** **Settings > Controls > Vibration strength** sets how strong the DualSense vibrates: 25%, 50%, 75% or 100% of what a game asks for. The controller answ

A game's settings are a page of their own, and Settings is a board of tiles.

emulators.name: gears of war 2 pc port
emulators.description: Gears of War 2 native PC port: the Xbox 360 game statically recompiled to x64 (not an emulator). 1440p/4K, FSR, 4K texture packs, keyboard & mouse, Android in progress. Bring your own copy.
emulators.latest_body:
## What's new

- **Android: the status bar no longer stays on top of the game (issue #40).** The game window opened as a normal window, so Android kept the status bar visible. It now opens fullscreen and hides the status and navigation bars; swiping from the edge shows them for a moment.
- **Faster native draws (Draw source → Direct3D calls).** Each native draw now applies its state in one block instead of one register at a time. This is the default path on Adreno phones (Draw source → Automatic), so Snapdragon players should get a bit more headroom. On our PC test (RX 7800 XT, chapter 2 hospital, Draw source → Direct3D calls) it went from 112-160 fps to 185-211 fps. PCs keep Console commands as the default, which is still faster there.
- **Shader cache lines in `gow2.log` (issue #37).** Two `SHADERSTORAGE` lines say how many shaders and pipelines the cache loaded at startup and how many were compiled while playing. They tell us whether stutters come from shaders compiling for the first time.
- **Less log spam on 4-core CPUs (issue #37).** "Too few processor cores" is written once, with the core count, instead of every time a game thread changes core.
- **Test tooling for issue #38

releases.name: v0.3.13
releases.body:
## What's new

- **Less CPU use, for 4-core PCs (issue #37).** One of the game's background threads, the one that runs queued work, kept a whole CPU core at 100 % even when it had nothing to do, at any frame rate. Now it sleeps 1 ms whenever its queue is empty. In the chapter 2 hospital on our test PC, the game's total CPU use at the normal 30 fps drops from about 1.7 cores to about 0.7, and limited to 4 cores with the frame rate unlocked it goes from 150 to 184 fps. A 12-minute run held 30 fps with no errors. On a 4-core CPU without Hyper-Threading that thread alone was a quarter of the machine. If something feels wrong (longer loading, stutters, missing sounds), `gow2_idle_worker_sleep = false` in `gow2.toml` brings the old behaviour back.
- **Combat dialogue language (issue #32):** documented in `docs/LANGUAGES.md`. Combat lines follow the subtitle language, not the voice language; to hear them in the voice language, pick that language for subtitles too.

**Windows zip replaced on 2026-11-05.** The first upload had `\` in its file paths, so on Linux it extracted into files named like `gow2-recomp-0.3.13-win64\keycaps\...` and the game did not start under Proton (issue #37). The

- **Android: Direct3D calls again on phones without Mali (issue #33).** 0.3.10 made Graphics → Draw source → Automatic use console commands on every phone, after a Mali player reported fewer stutters with them (#27). Automatic now picks Direct3D calls on Android unless the GPU is a Mali, which keeps console commands. PC does not change. If you set Draw source by hand, your choice stays.

releases.body:
## What's new

- **The update checker remembers what it found (PC).** It never saved its state, so it asked GitHub on every launch and **Skip this version** was forgotten. It now keeps `update_check.json` in the player data folder. Found thanks to the log in issue #24. Tested on PC (RX 7800 XT).
- Android: no changes besides the version number.

## Not tested yet

- **Frame counter** (Display → Frame counter, new in 0.3.10), on PC and Android.
- **0.3.10's two Android changes** (draw source default and finger scrolling): no reports from a phone yet.

## Known issues

- **Smearing on some AMD cards (issue #26):** on an RX 7900 XT and an RX 9070 XT the native renderer leaves smears and dark patches that follow the characters, with or without an upscaler. It does not happen on the RX 7800 XT we test on. Graphics → Renderer → **Emulated (EDRAM)** avoids it. A `gow2.log` from a run where it happens helps a lot.

releases.name: v0.3.10
releases.body:
## What's new

- **Launcher (PC).** PC Options now opens before the game loads, with a **Play** button (Esc / B). Changes that need a restart apply when you press Play: the game restarts itself before anything has loaded, then goes straight in. It works with a controller before the game starts (Steam Deck). System → **Show options at start** turns it off (`gow2_launcher`).
- **Texture packs (PC).**
  - Graphics → **Texture pack** picks a folder from `texture_packs` next to the game (or the old `textures` folder, or Off). **Open texture packs folder** opens it, so adding a pack is copying its folder there.
  - Graphics → **Build texture pack** upscales the textures you dumped (Graphics → **Dump textures**, then play the parts you want) with Real-ESRGAN on your own GPU and writes a pack you then pick: 2x or 4x, same format as the disc or BC7.   - Only colored textures of 128 px or more are upscaled. Normal maps, grayscale textures (masks, specular maps, light gradients), noise and small textures keep the disc version, because the upscaler made them worse in testing.

emulators.latest_body:
Scheduler and file I/O fixes from upstream Xenia Edge: file reads and writes finish the way they do on the console, and kernel timers and DPCs behave like the console's.

* Reads take about as long as they would on real storage, which some games need in order to load properly. A few games can take some seconds longer to start.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/phforner0/Xendroid-Plus/compare/XenDroid-v144-a107faa9...XenDroid-v146-d6dfac08

### 🛠️ Fixed

- Asynchronous reads no longer hold up a game's render thread, which upstream reports fixes frame drops during races in Project Gotham Racing 3.
- Opening, querying and renaming files no longer stalls the other game threads on that CPU.
- Cancelling a file request no longer lets it write into a buffer the game has reused.

releases.name: Xendroid+ 0.2.2
releases.body:
Fixes Forza Horizon drawing broken distant geometry at 6 fps in 0.2.1 on Adreno GPUs.

Fixes from upstream Xenia Edge: safer loading of game executables and DLLs, a batch of crash and memory-corruption fixes, and the right title update when a game has several installed.

A Vulkan driver that doesn't support the phone's GPU no longer closes every game without a word.

Analog triggers stay analog in games, and handhelds whose built-in controls Android lists twice, such as the AYN Thor, play as P1.

* Forza Horizon is back to 30 fps with a correct image on Adreno with Turnip.
* Games sharing a title ID with another edition (GTA IV and Episodes from Liberty City, Dragon Age: Origins and Awakening) get the title update built for them.
* A game waiting on the same object twice no longer freezes.
* Truncated ISOs, empty XMA audio buffers and network sends with no destination no longer crash the emulator.
* The game shows why it didn't start and offers the system driver.
* Racing games get throttle and brake control from analog triggers.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/phforner0/Xendroid-Plus/compare/XenDroid-v134-dba22de8...XenDroid-v144-a107faa9

emulators.latest_body:
**Beta, correções para Mali.** Em GPUs Mali, as cutscenes e o mundo ficavam a 0,5-1 fps ([#7](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/7)). Esta versão traz as correções de Mali do [BOTWRecompAndroid](https://github.com/mamcjr/BOTWRecompAndroid).

> **Nenhum arquivo do jogo vem junto.** Você precisa do seu próprio dump de *Tears of the Kingdom* com a atualização **1.4.3** aplicada (`exefs` e `romfs`, ou o `romfs` como um único `romfs.bin`).

Atualiza por cima da 0.2.0-beta e da 0.0.1-alpha sem apagar os saves. **Não desinstale o app antes**: isso apaga os saves.

## O que mudou

- **Mali: memória da GPU com cache.** Na Mali, a área de memória que os shaders usam ficava num tipo de memória sem cache. Toda leitura do que a GPU calculou era muito lenta, e por isso as cutscenes caíam para 1 fps. Agora ela usa a memória com cache, sincronizada manualmente.
- **Mali: sem queda de fps com o tempo.** Depois de carregamentos, a área de memória não se esgota mais e os draws não voltam a ser copiados pela CPU.
- **Mali: texturas BC1 menores.** Em GPUs sem BC (todas as Mali), as texturas BC1 viram ASTC 4x4 em vez de RGBA8. Ocupam um quarto da memória, o que diminui os fechamentos por falta de memória.
- **Mali com driver r54p1 ou mais novo:** a área de memória fica desligada nesses aparelhos, como no BOTW (lá, com ela ligada, o texto do jogo sumia).

## Hollow Knight: Silksong Android 2.0.0

**Note when updating from a previous version**: This will trigger the porting process again, but it is heavily cached, so should only take a few minutes.

This is a major release for this project, where the biggest change is that we have completely redesigned the bottom screen UI to feel more native to Silksongs design language. The bottom screen UI should now feel familiar to anyone who has used the in-game menu and any action can be taken from the bottom screen menu, making the in-game menu obsolete.

Thanks to Kaz Kirigiri for doing most of the design work and providing sketches for this revamped UI!

## Changes since 1.1.0

### Completely revamped bottom screen UI

- All tabs have been revamped to follow the in-game menu as close as possible
- Every action from the menu can now be done from the bottom screen. Use items, change crest and tools, place markers
- Smoothly animated item selection, tab switching, etc

## Changes since 2.0.0-rc1

### Dual screen
  - Zoom slider on the map: drag up to zoom in, down to zoom out. Fades out like RESET when you're not touching the map
  - Equipping and unequipping tools is animated: the tool flies

releases.name: v1.1.0
releases.body:
## Hollow Knight: Silksong Android 1.1.0

**Note when updating from a previous version**: This will trigger the porting process again, but it is heavily cached, so should only take a few minutes.

## Changes (since 1.0.3)

### Mods (beta)
- Mod support: install BepInEx 5 plugins from a folder, build them into the game, and turn them on and off without rebuilding
- Configuration Manager support (needs the mod installed, see docs. Press L3+R3 to open)

### Display
- New setting: **Unlock aspect ratio** — fills non-16:9 screens completely (off by default, as it can have visual issues)
- Fixed the video options menu showing no usable resolutions
- The game now stays landscape and no longer flips to vertical (which caused a squashed picture)

### Second screen
- The second screen now uses a native Android presentation layer, taking its touch input straight from the Android surface instead of through Unity. This may also fix the second screen not responding to taps on some devices, but that is unconfirmed
- Touching the second screen no longer skips cutscenes
- The second screen now hides when you minimise the game, and comes back with it
- The map now updates when you buy a new one from

releases.body:
- Fixes Android archive regeneration and setup dialogs
- **Note**: users already running 5.0.0-android.3 successfully do not need this update.

releases.name: 2 Ship 2 Harkinian Android 5.0.0-android.3
releases.body:
Fixes the device-specific startup crash caused by an outdated or mismatched support archive.

Highlights:
- Verifies the installed support archive against the APK and repairs it safely when needed
- Confirms the required OpenGL shader is present before startup
- Tries one recovery launch without mods after a native startup failure
- Preserves the selected Android menu scale between launches
- Adds clearer native crash details for shader and startup failures

Existing users can install this APK over the previous signed release. Mods and enabled-mod settings are preserved. Recovery mode skips mods for one launch only and does not change the mod list.

Crash reports remain local and are never uploaded automatically.

# Eden Encore — validated native PS5 test package

**Source SHA:** `5629395324ff65c98b50c44f35f2142a4a92654a`

**Successful native CI:** https://github.com/niakw/Prospero.Eden-Encore/actions/runs/38752177232

This ZIP is repackaged from the *existing successful CI artifact*,
without recompiling or changing `PPSA99008/`.
It is a **test pre-release**, not a stable R1.

The selected All-On test build compiles shared and successor-batch JIT
and materializes active I-cache and host service-wait fixes.
The unsafe dummy-thread wait patch remains excluded. Source/build
verification is not evidence that gameplay freezes, HUD delays or
cold-start stutters are fixed on the physical console.

directory. Do not rename the title ID.

and materializes active I-cache and host service-wait fixes.

cold-start stutters are fixed on the physical console.

FTP: extract and upload the complete PPSA99008/ folder into
/data/homebrew/, resulting in /data/homebrew/PPSA99008/.
The ZIP stores Unix permission 0777 for every file and folder.
Some FTP clients strip these permissions: apply 0777 recursively
on the console if CE-107750-0 appears. Do not rename PPSA99008
or overwrite personal files under /data/prosperoeden.

emulators.description: PS5 emulator（早期原型 v0.0.1，官方 release 直链）
emulators.latest_body:
Fifth alpha of the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android. Mali GPUs on their system driver can now run games, and the FPS counter shows how many frames CapyPS5 Framegen adds. Existing installs are offered this update in the app.

**New**
- **Mali on the system driver:** that driver cannot sample BCn compressed textures, so the GPU used to be rejected. CapyPS5 now decompresses those textures on the GPU when it uploads them (BC1 to BC7, including BC6H HDR textures). GPUs that support BCn keep using it directly.
- **PanVK on Mali:** the GPU is no longer rejected when the driver lacks vertex-stage stores or dual-source blending.
- **Framegen counter:** with CapyPS5 Framegen on, the FPS counter reads *XX FPS - YY FG*: XX are the game's own frames, YY the total including generated ones. The options are now called *Framegen x2*, *x3* and *x4*.
- **HDR10 output:** games that output HDR10 are converted to SDR for the screen.

**Fixed**
- Tessellation: quad domains, fractional-even spacing, counterclockwise output and masked hull control points.
- New shader instructions (16-bit multiply-add and ternary operations, VOP3 conversions, S_QUADMASK_B32, V_ASHRREV_I64) and faster shader transla

releases.name: CapyPS5 v0.0.4
releases.body:
Fourth alpha of the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android. More than 100 games now run correctly according to testers' reports, and this release adds CapyPS5 Framegen. Existing installs are offered this update in the app.

**New**
- **CapyPS5 Framegen:** optional frame generation. It draws in-between frames from the motion between two game frames, so a game at 30 FPS is shown at 60. Off by default; turn it on in *Settings → Performance* (1 per frame, or up to 3). Adds one frame of latency and some GPU load; works best from 25 FPS up.
- New performance options in *Settings → Performance*: shadow resolution, early depth testing and a frame rate limit (30 or 20 FPS).
- Physical keyboard input and an on-screen keyboard toggle for text fields, and system dialogs that can now be answered.
- Android 16 and devices with 16 KB memory pages are supported.

**Fixed**
- Unreal Engine 5 games: graphics and async compute hand work back and forth several times per frame, and each hand-off waited up to 100 ms. Menus that ran at 0–2 FPS now move.
- Games whose shadows use depth-compare texture gathers (Castlevania: Belmont's Curse) closed after the menu.
- Games built with MONITORX/MWAITX instru

releases.name: CapyPS5 v0.0.3
releases.body:
Third alpha of the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android. Fixes for the logs testers sent on v0.0.2, CPU work for Unreal Engine games, and more from KytyPS5. Existing installs are offered this update in the app.

**Fixed**
- Games that use fibers (sceFiber) closed the emulator at start on ARM ("Fiber context switching is only implemented on x86_64", Toy Story Retro Roundup). Fibers now switch the game's own registers. First support: please report how fiber games behave.
- Final Fantasy VII Rebirth: sceKernelFtruncate, which it calls when saving, is now available.
- Mewgenics: pthread_setcanceltype is now available.
- The game clock (RDTSC) ran about 23 % faster than the frequency games are told; they now match.
- Very large GPU compute dispatches (over 65535 groups, as in Astro Bot) are split to fit Adreno limits.
- Unity backtraces no longer follow a bogus frame at the start of each guest thread.

**New**
- Unreal Engine games: the TLS and process clock reads they make millions of times a second run inside the game code instead of calling into the emulator.
- Shaders can read the real GPU clock (S_MEMREALTIME) on drivers that offer it.
- JpegDec and JpegEnc libraries, and more

releases.name: CapyPS5 v0.0.2 (Alpha)
releases.body:
Second alpha of the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android. Fixes for what testers reported on v0.0.1, a trophy screen, and 60 games on the compatibility list. Existing installs are offered this update in the app.

**Fixed**
- Virtual controller: several buttons can now be held at once.
- Physical controllers: the left stick no longer presses the d-pad (it moved menus and cursors, as in Mewgenics).
- Adreno 6xx with Turnip (such as Adreno 660) no longer closes at start for lack of 8-bit storage (thanks to deivid22srk).
- Dead Cells has its music, hits and footsteps back: NGS2 voices sent to a rack handle are now heard.
- Games that use user clip planes or uncommon storage texture settings no longer close.

**New**
- Trophies: each game's trophy list, what you have earned, and a card to share your progress.
- A "What's new" card after each update.
- Over 35 improvements from KytyPS5: shaders, tessellation, NGS2 and ATRAC9 audio, flip waits and fewer crashes.

**Requirements:** Android 12+ (arm64), a Vulkan 1.3 GPU, 12 GB of RAM recommended, and your own PS5 game dumps. Tested on Adreno 830 (AYN Odin 3) and by testers on Snapdragon 8 Elite, 8 Gen 3, 888 and Mali. Other GPUs: downlo

releases.name: CapyPS5 v0.0.1 (Alpha)
releases.body:
The first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android. **Alpha:** a handful of games run, some at full speed; many are slow or don't boot yet. The app tells you when a new version is out.

**Requirements:** Android 12+ (arm64), a Vulkan 1.3 GPU, 12 GB of RAM recommended, and your own PS5 game dumps. Tested on Adreno 830 (AYN Odin 3). Other Adreno GPUs and Mali: download a Turnip or PanVK driver in *Settings → Graphics → Download drivers*.

**Playable at 60 FPS on the Odin 3:** Dead Cells, Blasphemous, Animal Well, Greak: Memories of Azur, The Binding of Isaac: Repentance, Monster Boy. Full list in the README and on https://capyps5.org.

**Includes no games, BIOS, firmware or Sony keys, and needs none.** Only use games dumped from your own console.

Report problems on Discord (https://discord.com/invite/PEE7Q5TVM5) with the log the app saves when a game closes.

# Virtual Jaguar libretro v3.9.1

**Xenowings gets its sound effects back, Doom's GPU wait loop no longer eats a RISC overclock,
and the desktop app gains shaders on every package, an Interface settings tab and a new font
picker.**

v3.9.1 is a polish release on top of v3.9.0. For RetroArch and Provenance users it brings two
DSP/GPU accuracy fixes derived from the original chip netlists, a faster GPU idle-loop
fast-forward, a GDB stub that works with stock gdb, a framebuffer bounds fix, loader fixes for
twelve homebrew and demo files, and working legacy MSVC Windows builds again. With default
settings the cartridge corpus is byte-identical to v3.9.0 except Xenowings (sound effects now

emulators.latest_body:
What's new in 0.78

For players
- **32-bit devices:** one APK now holds both ARMv8 (arm64-v8a) and ARMv7
  (armeabi-v7a). Android picks the right one on install, so 64-bit devices
  always run the 64-bit version. OpenGL ES 3.0 is still required.
- **Screen orientation:** the setting now applies to the launcher as well as
  the game and takes effect at once. Auto respects the system rotation lock.
- **Sound:** the audio buffer margin now adapts to the device.
- **Launcher:** new Advanced screen with a Debug mode switch. With it off,
  nothing is written to the log.
- **Logs:** new screen under Data to export, share or send logs to the
  developer, or clear them.

Under the hood
- **Most of the game is now ported C++:** - game code is moving from recompiled to ported native ARM code.
- **Old processor code removed:** x87 emulation is gone from the generated
  code, and the whole game runs in 24-bit floating point. MMX, CPU detection
  and the Pentium FDIV workarounds are removed too.

Known limits
- ARMv7 has only been tested in the 32-bit mode of a 64-bit phone, not on a
  real 32-bit device, so speed on older hardware is unknown.
- Network play is not compatible anymore with PC Mod

What's new:

### For players
- **Dynamic Fullscreen for races.** A new Screen Size option that fits the race to your phone's shape (20:9, 16:9, tablets) with no black bars, you can find it in Resolution tabs in-game Graphics settings. The view widens to the sides and the HUD keeps its proportions. It is the default for new imports. 
- **Options on the first screen.** The "NFS Web Site" button is now "Options...", so the settings are one tap away.
- **Gamepads: Analog or Digital** (Controls → Gamepads). In Digital mode you steer with the D-pad and use the triggers for gas and brake, like a keyboard.
- **Force feedback: one choice, Off / Phone / Gamepad**, instead of two separate switches. The in-game Stick Volume slider now actually sets the vibration strength (it used to always be full).
- **Dead zone and saturation** from the game's own Dead Zone screen now work, separately for the stick and each trigger.
- **The demo movie no longer freezes** on its last frame.
- **Split screen** uses the Modern Patch layout.

### Under the hood (same behaviour, now native code instead of recompiled)
- **Sound:** the eacsnd driver and the game's mixer with reverb are native and play straight thro

releases.name: v0.76
releases.body:
What's new:

- New launcher UI on Compose.
- Network races work: phone with phone over Wi-Fi (IPX or TCP/IP), and phone with a PC running the Modern Patch over TCP/IP, as host or client.
- Disc image import: the launcher reads the game straight from an ISO or BIN/CUE image, on the first start and on the Data screen.
- Faster and cooler: the renderer driver and about fifty of the game's heaviest functions now run as native code. Each was checked bit for bit against the original. Removed voodoo2a emulation wrapper - now GPU code is fully native OpenGLES. 
- Rear-view mirror like the main view: full draw distance, track detail, full-size cars, sky with clouds and lightning, car lights and headlights.
- Fixed bugs on certain devices with saves.

# 1.4.4 更新说明

## Steam 下载

- 修正下载专用扫码授权，通过 Steam Client 的 CM 会话获取下载授权；应用内账号登录继续保留独立流程。
- 修正 PICS 的 `appinfo` 包装层解析，补齐受限内容资料访问令牌及大型资料获取，解决“depot 无可用 manifest”。
- 支持 Steam 返回的中国 CDN 类型和主机，并遵循服务器的 HTTPS 要求。
- 支持加密 manifest 文件名，兼容 Base64 中的换行和空白，解决扫码授权后仍无法完成下载的问题。
- 游戏下载到 `Download/com.vintage.pomelopro/games/steam/<appid>`，完成后加入本地游戏库；暂存目录不显示为游戏，已有目录不会被覆盖。
- 修正目录大小写导致的标题及已下载状态识别失败。
- 登录错误读取 Steam 返回的结果码，改善认证拒绝与请求频繁的提示。

## 版本与验证

- 应用版本：`1.4.4`，版本代码：`1004004`。
- 下载修复已通过 HAP 编译及 Steam 回归检查；平板实测 RPG Maker XP 完成下载并正确识别 `RPGXP.exe`。
- 启动 RPG Maker XP 会拉起 Windows 版 Steam；该客户端的登录窗口仍为白屏，尚未验证 RPG Maker XP 可正常使用。下载成功不代表需要 Steam 客户端认证的程

- Used package name - emuready.gamehub.lite
- Signed with testkey

Official API version:
- Uses GameSir server for downloading firmware/drivers/other components, usually up to date, may have privacy concerns
- More cluttered My Games list, includes PC/PS Link (idk if it is working)
- Can import Android games
- No login required
- Offline is working

EmuReady API version:
- Uses EmuReady server to download firmware/drivers/other components, more private
- Has more GPU drivers to download, but may not have the latest components to download
- Clean My Games list (only Windows emulation and Steam)
- Can't import Android games
- No login required
- Offline is working

Only difference in APK files are https server strings, everything else is the same!

## Changelog

This is the first anniversary of Eden's inception, on May 10, 2025. It has been quite a hectic journey thus far, from drama, to server nukes, to DMCAs, to sysadmin nightmares, to exotic hardware/OS ports, to constant threats from all angles. Yet still, we survive, with countless improvements, bug fixes, performance enhancements, features, and so much more to show for it.

Thank you all so, so much for the constant support in the face of continuous, unending challenges and difficulties. Here's to many more years of Eden, and for the time being, enjoy 0.2.0 as your anniversary gift!

You are encouraged to read the [detailed changelog](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/compare/v0.2.0-rc2...v0.2.0).

- New 1st anniversary icon
- Firmware 22.0 compatibility
- Removed the separate logging thread

- Stubbed GetFriendListForViewerV2
  - Qlaunch will no longer crash when viewing friends

- Updates and DLC without installing to NAND
- A grid and icon-only view for desktop
- Direct mod import from a folder or zip file
- Turbo and Slow mode toggles

And, of course, your usual dose of performance improvements, bug fixes, and regression fixes from earlier versions.
If you wish to see the *full* changelog, check out <https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/compare/v0.1.1...v0.2.0-rc1> as always.

Enjoy, and happy (late, for our more eastward friends) Valentine's Day!

## Universal

- Updates and DLCs can now be selected and used without having to install them to NAND
  * On Android, this is done in Settings -> Manage Game Folders -> \"+\" -> External Content Folder
  * On Desktop, this is done in Settings -> General -> External Content
- Added configurable speed-up and slow-down hotkeys
  * On Android, this is located in the Quick Settings menu
- Some frequently-used sets and maps have been replaced with a faster implementation
- The web token and username are now generated automatically
- The console and battery serial are now generated automatically
  * This may safeguard against adve

This is a hotfix release that addresses several UI and platform-specific bugs present in the 0.1.0 release, alongside some bonus fixes and UX improvements.

- Fixed the overlay applet causing crashes

- **aarch64/arm64**: For devices that use the armv8-a instruction set; e.g. Snapdragon X, all Android devices, and Apple Silicon Macs.

releases.name: Release21
releases.body:
1. Added support for terminal application notifications via the kitty OSC 99 protocol (used in opencode 2.0.  However, its current notification implementation is buggy, and a notification sent from one session is duplicated by every other running opencode session. To address this, the app includes a "Notification deduplication" workaround, though it cannot guarantee accurate identification of the source session.)
2. Added the option to enable the input bar above the terminal. 
3. Fixed various issues when using the bubble window. 
4. Fixed terminal rendering issues in certain scenarios (fixed color fill bugs in Vim when resizing the terminal window, and eliminated garbled output when displaying Hindi characters).
5. Improved handling of display cutouts, and added an option to extend the window into the cutout area.

Hotfix: fixed input panel and extra button panel hide behaviour in some cases

releases.name: Release20

3. Input panel height is limited to a quarter of the app window height
4. Fixed translation strings

releases.body:
Pocket2Droid 1.0.2 adds Windows Mobile 5.0 support, Internet access and more customization.

- **Windows Mobile 5.0:** Added support for compatible Device Emulator ROM images.
- **Internet access:** Connect to the Internet inside Windows Mobile through your Android device’s connection. Internet access is enabled by default for new ROM profiles.
- **If Internet access doesn’t work:** Make sure Internet access is **On** in Pocket2Droid’s ROM settings. Inside Windows Mobile, open **Network Cards** settings and change **“My network card connects to”** from **Work** to **The Internet**. Tap **OK**, then try browsing again. Some network configurations still require manual setup, and older browsers may not support modern HTTPS websites.
- **Custom resolutions:** Set your own guest screen width and height alongside the existing presets. Compatibility varies by ROM. Custom resolutions may cause display glitches or require touchscreen recalibration inside Windows Mobile.
- **Restart option:** Restart Windows Mobile directly from the session menu.
- **Per-ROM StorageCard folders:** Choose a separate StorageCard folder for each ROM while keeping the general StorageCard folder unchanged.

releases.name: Pocket2Droid v1.0.1 — First Public Release
releases.body:
First public release of Pocket2Droid, a Windows Mobile emulator for Android that runs the complete operating system, including compatible applications and games.

### Features
- ROM library with individual settings and persistent storage.
- Shared StorageCard folder with file importing.
- On-screen controls with adjustable transparency, vibration feedback and multi-key support.
- Global button mapping for keyboards and wired/Bluetooth controllers, including sticks and triggers.
- Display scaling, orientation, screen position and fullscreen options.

### Requirements
- ARM64 Android device running Android 7.0 or newer.
- A compatible Windows Mobile `.bin` ROM.

ROMs, games and applications are not included.

### Getting started
1. Install the APK attached below.
2. Open Pocket2Droid and grant storage access.
3. Tap **+ → PPC Rom** to import your ROM.
4. Tap the ROM to start Windows Mobile.

To copy files into the guest’s storage card, use **+ → File to StorageCard**.

### Please note
- Compatibility and performance vary by device, ROM and game.

[Discord](https://discord.gg/cVHYSwn9Bq) · [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@Pocket2Droid)

releases.body:
﻿DingooEmu v0.3.0

DingooEmu 第三个正式版本，首次支持 Gemei A330 平台（CC/C2S/C3S），新增 A330 ARM JIT，并加入独立版实体手柄输入，同时修复多项音频与兼容性问题。

## ✨ 新功能

### 平台扩展
- 首次支持 Gemei A330：可加载 CC/C2S/C3S 内容（#51）
- 新增 A330 ARM JIT，加速 A330 游戏运行（#56）

### 独立运行版
- 通过 gilrs 支持实体手柄输入（#61）

### 核心改进
- 新增可选性能诊断功能（#26，#46）
- 实现 get_current_language HLE（#47）
- 实现 OSTaskDel HLE（#48）

## 🐛 Bug 修复

### A330 运行时
- 修复 A330 后台音频任务调度（#55）
- A330 堆分配清零初始化（#57，#58）
- A330 访客时钟与音频队列按墙钟节流（#60）

### 音频与稳定性
- 恢复 libretro 22050 Hz 音频输出（#53）
- 内容结束时请求前端关闭（#49）
- 提高 save-state 解码大小上限（#50）
- 改进 Android JIT 吞吐与音频响应（#31，#26）

releases.name: DingooEmu v0.2.0
releases.body:
DingooEmu v0.2.0

DingooEmu 第二个正式版本，新增 MIPS32 JIT 编译后端，大幅提升 Android 平台运行性能，并修复了多项游戏兼容性问题。

## ✨ 新功能

### 性能优化
- 新增 MIPS32 到原生代码的分层 JIT 后端，支持 64 位 Android 平台 (#23)
- 优化访客指令获取，缓存直接映射指令块并批量计数
- 优化 libretro RGB565 视频输出路径
- 优化 Android 3D 运行时性能 (#20)
- 限制内存写入跟踪到调试构建，提升发布版性能

### 核心改进
- 在 RetroArch 中新增 CPU 执行引擎选项（JIT/解释器），支持 Android 平台实时切换
- 缓存失效时自动释放 JIT 代码，避免内存泄漏

## 🐛 Bug 修复

### 运行兼容性
- 支持更新版本的游戏构建，修复部分游戏启动失败的问题 (#25)
- 修复输入轮询机制，改善游戏输入响应 (#25)
- 修复 Android JIT 构建兼容性，支持 buildbot Rust 版本

### 稳定性
- 移除分级兼容性测试基础设施，简化测试流程 (#24)

releases.name: DingooEmu v0.1.0
releases.body:
DingooEmu v0.1.0

DingooEmu 首个正式版本，支持运行 Dingoo A320 平台的 `.app` 游戏文件，提供独立运行版和 libretro 核心两种使用方式。

## ✨ 新功能

### 核心模拟
- 实现兼容 Ingenic JZ4740 XBurst 的 MIPS32 CPU 解释器
- 支持解析和加载 Dingoo A320 `.app` 游戏容器
- 以 HLE 方式实现图形、输入、音频、计时、文件、任务和系统等 Dingoo SDK 功能
- 支持持久化游戏存档、事务式即时存档和金手指

### 图形与音频
- 支持 320×240 RGB565 帧缓冲，并输出 XRGB8888 画面
- 支持 PCM 音频播放、格式转换、音量控制和重采样
- 使用有界音频队列和背压机制改善连续播放的稳定性
- 支持无窗口截图和批量截图，可用于自动化测试与预览生成

### 独立运行版与 RetroArch
- 独立运行版提供显示、音频、输入、诊断、金手指和自动化无窗口运行等完整命令行选项
- libretro 核心支持视频、音频、RetroPad 输入、重置、持久化存档、即时存档和金手指
- 支持在 RetroArch 中实时调整音频、输入、日志和解释器诊断选项
- 提供 Windows、Linux、macOS、Android、iOS 和 webOS 构建

### 兼容性与测试
- 新增未知 SDK 调用汇总、严格执行策略和允许列表，便于定位未实现功能
- 新增可复现的 JSON/CSV 兼容性报告，以及确定性输入和 PCM 音频检查点
- 完善独立运行版、RetroArch、Android、iOS 和发布流程文档 (#9)

## 🐛 Bug 修复

### 运行兼容性
- 修复只读游戏资源无法读取的问题，并在实际写入路径中正确执行写保护 (#12)
- 修复旧版应用布局的 LCD 初始化，并实现 LL、SC 和 TEQ 指令以改善游戏启动兼容性 (#12)
- 实现目录枚举、通配符匹配和路径限制，修复部分游戏因文件搜索无法结束而停留在标题画面的问题 (#12)
- 实现聚焦窗口的按键消息派发，修复部分菜单无法响应输入的问题 (#12)

### 音频与稳定性
- 修复 PCM 音频行为和队列背压，改善音频连续性与运行稳定性 (#11)
- 保存文件搜索和 GUI 派发状态，确保即时存档加载后的行为一致 (#12)

## v0.1.23 (2026-07-07)

> _Report anything that misbehaves._

**New — Mii selector & creator**
- In-game **"Create a Mii"** (Miitopia, and any title that calls the Switch Mii applet) now opens a
  real, gamepad-navigable Mii selector: pick one of your existing system Miis, generate a random
  Mii, or cancel — instead of the game being silently handed a blank default face. A random Mii is
  saved into your system Mii database, so games that re-read it pick it up too.
- Guest applet dialogs — the Mii selector, profile selection, and controller-connect prompts — now
  **render and are fully controller-drivable in Game Mode**. Previously, because a guest applet
  pauses the game, the emulator's frame loop went idle and the overlay never composited over the
  frozen frame (it showed as a black screen); it now re-composites the overlay over the held frame,
  so the menu appears over your game and the D-pad / A / B drive it, handing control back cleanly.
- **Direct Mii Creator access** from the launcher top bar — the full Mii editor is one button away,
  as befits a Switch headline feature.

**New — Deck-native input**
- **Deck touchscreen → Switch touch**: tapping and dragging on the De

releases.name: Ryudeck v0.1.22
releases.body:
**New — Frame Generation (experimental)**
- **Frame Generation ships as an opt-in**: toggle it live in the Quick-Access blade (L3+R3) or per
  game in settings. It runs AMD FidelityFX optical-flow frame interpolation inside Ryudeck's own
  Vulkan present path — no external layers — presenting an interpolated frame between each pair of
  real frames on a dedicated present thread. GPU-light titles roughly double their perceived
  frame rate (measured on device: ~21-30 fps rendered → ~42-60 presented).
- It is self-limiting by design: generation only engages when it actually helps — it suspends below
  a per-title frame-rate floor, when the GPU has no spare headroom (measured from real per-frame GPU
  time, so misreported "100% busy" titles are handled), and when the game already runs near panel
  rate. A zero-delay dip veto skips generation for any single spiked frame (e.g. a shader-compile
  stall), so sudden hitches are never smeared into interpolated frames.
- Fixed: the feature now engages reliably on every launch (previously a first-launch state could
  latch process-wide), the blade reports its live state honestly (including a "restart game" hint
  when a change needs one), an

- Fixed a per-frame Vulkan memory allocation in the FSR upscaler (the default scaler) that blocked the render thread on GPU fences hundreds of times per second under load. Heavy titles no longer dip as hard when the camera moves — every game running the FSR scaler benefits.

- **Console Mode**: choose Docked or Handheld globally *and* per game, with a live mode tag in the overlay. Your per-game choice always outranks the built-in recommendation.
- **Cheats in the Quick-Access blade** (L3+R3): browse and toggle individual cheats live, in-game.
- **Boot lands on your last-played game**; launcher + overlays navigate with the left thumbstick too.

- Fixed a hard render-thread crash on an out-of-range texture format (hit in Tea

- **Problem:** Monsters only attacked when the HOST was nearby. If only the CLIENT approached, the monster would remain still.

## Pacman suite (packaging revision 2)

Download **`termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz`** and its `.sha256` file. This is a real Pacman package:

```sh
sha256sum -c termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz.sha256
pacman -U ./termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz
```

It directly owns the native runtime and API commands and stages both APKs under `$PREFIX/share/termux-aether-suite`. Update Android apps using `aether-apks api`, then `aether-apks app`; Android confirms these updates. Existing app IDs, signatures and data paths are preserved. Shizuku and Arch images remain optional.

If you previously installed Aether commands manually, download `aether-install.py` and its checksum too:

```sh
sha256sum -c aether-install.py.sha256
python aether-install.py --adopt-legacy ./termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz
```

This backs up only the nine known unowned legacy commands and transfers ownership to Pacman. Unrelated files/packages are refused. GameNative for Mali handhelds, rebased on upstream GameNative 1.2.1.

**Proof of concept, released as is. No support:** I do not answer bug reports or questions, and I do not take requests for devices I do not own.

Download `gamenative-mali-modern.apk` below and install it. It installs next to the stock GameNative app (package `app.gamenative.mali`). It is debug-signed with this repository's fixed key, so it upgrades over earlier `mali` builds signed with the same key.

## What changed

- **Custom driver support for PanVK on Mali.** Import a Mesa PanVK package for your device in **Driver Manager**, then select it for a game under **Graphics**. No PanVK build is bundled, and the default stays the system driver.
- A Mali device no longer lists Turnip or Qualcomm drivers, and a container that names one falls back to the system driver.
- Rebased on upstream GameNative 1.2.1.

**Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ2** — an independent rebranded build of CapyPS5 v0.0.3, the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android (built on KytyPS5 and the FEX x86-64 JIT).

## v0.0.9proQ2 — heavy-game crash fix, 90/120 Hz unlock, hot-pipeline compilation, deeper Snapdragon + Mali profiles (same graphics)

- **Fixed: heavy Unreal Engine titles no longer crash seconds into gameplay.** GPU-driven draw batches (DrawIndirectMulti) read their draw counts and argument buffers from game memory that the game is free to release; a read that landed on freed memory faulted inside libc and ended the session with "Unhandled host exception ... in DrawIndirectMulti". Every such guest read is now guarded: the count goes through the fault-safe reader, and the two raw copies of the guest read path run behind a fault guard that unwinds cleanly - a batch whose arguments vanished is skipped, exactly like a real GPU reading zero from an unmapped address, and the page is evicted from the thread's cache so the next read probes instead of faulting. **Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ1** — an independent rebranded build of CapyPS5 v0.0.3, the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android (built on KytyPS5 and the FEX x86-64 JIT).

## v0.0.9proQ1 — crash fixes, import/storage fixes + much deeper GPU optimization (same graphics)

- **Fixed: the app could crash right after importing a game.** Importing the same executable twice (typically a retry after the game crashed) added two library entries with the same key, which the game grid cannot render — the app died with "Key ... was already used". Imports now run one at a time (a second pick while a multi-GB copy is still running no longer races the first), a completed import reuses the existing library entry instead of adding a twin, and the grid list itself is deduplicated as a last line of defence.

**Console Five Pro v0.0.9pro** — an independent rebranded build of CapyPS5 v0.0.3, the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android (built on KytyPS5 and the FEX x86-64 JIT).

## New in v0.0.9pro — deep GPU optimization, scrollable game options

- **Mali GPU optimization (Settings → Performance, Auto by default)**: on Mali GPUs (Mali-G76 class and newer) the emulator now detects the GPU at Vulkan device creation and applies bandwidth-tuned defaults — **with exactly the same graphics**:
  - **Hardware render-target clears**: pass clears now use Vulkan `loadOp CLEAR` instead of loading the previous contents and clearing inside the pass. On Mali, loading a render target forces an AFBC (Arm Frame Buffer Compression) decompress of data that is immediately overwritten; hardware clears are free and keep AFBC compression alive — far less memory traffic on a GPU family that is bandwidth-bound.
  - **128 MB streaming buffer** (up from 64 MB): the upload ring wraps half as often, so games that stream geometry and textures heavily wait on the GPU less.
  - **One more pipeline-compile worker**: Mali shader compiles are slower, so material warm-up finishes sooner and streaming games hitch less.

# Packages

## Targets

Each build is optimized for a specific architecture and uses a specific compiler.

- **aarch64/arm64**: For devices that use the armv8-a instruction set; e.g. Snapdragon X, all Android devices, and Apple Silicon Macs.
- **amd64**: For devices that use the amd64 (aka x86_64) instruction set; this is exclusively used by Intel and AMD CPUs and is only found on desktops.
- **v3**: For devices that use the x86_64-v3 instruction set or newer; this is found on Ryzen, Intel 4th Generation (Haswell), and newer.

### PGO

PGO builds usually perform ~10-30% better than standard builds, and are thus generally recommended for all users.

## Linux

Linux packages are distributed via AppImage.

Rollback is what makes NetPlay feel like two people on one machine instead of
two people waiting for each other. This release is mostly about the games that
could not use it, and the sessions that fell apart halfway through.

All of CPS-3 does: 3rd Strike and the earlier two, JoJo's Bizarre Adventure,
Red Earth. Until now these were stuck in Lockstep, which is the worst place for
a fighting game to be.

The problem was size. To rewind, rollback keeps dozens of snapshots of the

only what the game actually writes to. What used to be far past any sane limit
now fits with room to spare.

Games that already fit benefit too: smaller snapshots mean less memory and less
work on every correction.

releases.name: MAME4droid 2026(0.289) 1.40.6
releases.body:
## Added NetPlay Public Rooms

Until now, NetPlay worked over the internet with no account, no relay, and no service to trust. The one thing it could not do was find you an opponent: you still had to know someone already, and swap an IP address with them by hand.

**Public Rooms** is that missing half. It's an optional board where hosts advertise the game they are hosting, so anyone with the same ROM can tap it and connect.

What it is *not* is a relay. The board introduces two players and then steps out of the way — the match still runs directly between the two devices, exactly as it did before, and nothing about it passes through any server of mine. 

### On the board

* **Room codes.** Every room gets a short code you can pass to a friend. 
* **PIN rooms.** Tick *Require PIN* and the room still appears, marked as protected, but only the people you told can get in. The PIN itself never reaches the server — only a hash of it does.
* **A color-coded connection forecast.** Green, amber, or red per room, based on what STUN actually measured about both routers rather than a guess. Two symmetric NATs with no way through show red and refuse the join.
* **Same-network rooms are flagged**

releases.name: MAME4droid 2026(0.289) 1.38.3
releases.body:
New in 1.38.3: Controller rework: 10 buttons per player, numbered naming and savestate fixes

- Two extra gamepad buttons per player (10 total), for pads with back paddles
  or a full face cluster.
- Buttons renamed from letters to numbers (BTN1..BTN10) in the mapping screen,
  the on-screen art and the OSD, so they no longer clash with the pad's A/B/X/Y.
- Deleting a savestate now goes through SAF, so it really disappears from
  MAME's list instead of lingering as a stale cache entry.
- Save/load state menus: every face button can name a slot, BTN1 and BTN2
  included.

NOTE: custom controller mappings reset to defaults on upgrade, since the
  added buttons shifted every stored index.

****

New in 1.38.2: Netplay menu/Lua, touch lightgun fixes, full emulation area and vector polish

Netplay
- MAME's menu and Lua plugins now work during netplay: the menu combo is
  intercepted through a side channel and stripped from the synced input.
- New "Allow Lua plugins in netplay" preference, off by default

Touch lightgun
- Aiming maps to the game screen inside the canvas instead of the whole view,
  fixing the drift towards the edges with artwork or the full emulation area.
- Long press n

New in 1.37.6: Added support for frame pacing and ADPF for improved performance on compatible devices. Fixes.
****

****
New in 1.37.4: New native system font rendering. Smarter haptics. Fixes.

****

****
New in 1.37.1: i18n & fixes

## 1.37 NetPlay

This release introduces **NetPlay**: play the same game together over Wi-Fi or the internet, built from scratch as a native part of MAME4droid rather than bolted on.

### Two sync modes:
- **Rollback** — save-state resimulation for near-zero input lag, ideal for fighting games and fast action titles. Boot is fully deterministic (RTC, samplerate, disk/NVRAM state pinned), so only inputs ever cross the network — nothing bulky to transfer at connect time.
- **Lockstep** — simple guaranteed sync for titles where rollback doesn't apply cleanly.
- A **CRC desync detector** watches the session and warns you the moment two machines drift apart, and a one-tap

releases.name: MAME4droid 2026(0.288) 1.36.6
releases.body:
New in 1.36.6:

- Added Full-Screen Vector CRT Monitor Glow. Simulates the physical off-screen light scattering of the original arcade hardware (Starwars).
- Optimizations.

****

New in 1.36.4:

Replaced the vector CPU-generated geometric glow with a pure GPU optical post-processing pipeline (Dual-Filter Kawase 13-taps/9-taps via FBOs). This shift in vector rendering unlocks the true potential of the HDR engine. By physically scattering raw light energy rather than faking it with geometry.

****

**Core Update:**

- Updated to MAME 0.288 (For a full list of changes, visit the official MAME website).

**Major GLES Graphics Overhaul:**

Major overhaul of the MAME4droid GLES graphics pipeline, introducing a significantly improved rendering architecture for both raster and vector games.

1. Advanced Vector CRT Simulation:

    - Complete rewrite of the vector rendering engine to replicate the physical and optical properties of classic arcade CRT monitors.
    - Physically-inspired electron beam simulation with enhanced optical bloom and light diffusion effects.
    - Improved phosphor persistence, realistic color blending, and accurate crosstalk behavior.
    - Dynamic beam intensity

# Pine Developer Diagnostics v1.3 — 开发预览

**这是诊断增强，不是 ART GC/堆损坏根因修复。** 复用已审查的 Debug APK，不重建、不重签；main 与旧预览 tag 不变。

源提交：`99115d70560c4872a094462bb179e0b772484d7f`；[草稿 PR #2](https://github.com/xmy953538104/pine_CN/pull/2)。

本轮修复 trace 临时失败的有限重试与成功升级导出、轮转后完整关键字段、CNMT/Program/SaveOwner 身份分离、按 generation 清理与 Java 故障身份保留，以及原生身份回调的共享实例锁。DFX 只来自真实 guest 消息；不保证闭源 Lua 栈。

## 实际验证

- FullDebug 构建、101 项 JVM、native/core/content、Windows PS5.1/pwsh 假 ADB 与匹配符号通过。
- Diagnostics CI 执行 `testFullDebugUnitTest processFullReleaseMainManifest assembleFullDebug`；原 CI 执行 `assembleFulldebug`。Release manifest 处理通过，**不称 FullRelease APK 构建通过**。
- 官方 API35 x86_64 / `libndk_translation.so` 的 ARM64 APK 实际运行结果如下。属于翻译环境，不是物理 ARM64/NCE/商业游戏验收。

| 平台 | 实际报告 | 通过 | 阻塞 | 证据 |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| Linux | environment_blocked | 5 | 13 | [原始证据](https://github.com/xmy953538104/pine_CN/actions/runs/39033021235/artifacts/12101598679) |
| Mac | verified | 18 | 0 | [原始证据](https://github.com/xmy953538104/pine_CN/actions/runs/39033021235/artifacts/12100794725) |

Mac 18/18 包含真实设置、默认关闭、开关/Session、原生 JSONL、PineDiag、等级/保留/类别、导出预览、私有快照、DocumentsUI SAF ZIP 逐字节匹配及 Stop。两个平台均观察到一次 System UI ANR，并记录一次普通 Wait 操作。Mac 随后完成18项；Linux

This is a Diagnostics v1 developer preview, packaged as a Debug APK for owner testing.
It installs alongside Pine and the old diagnostics app as **Pine Diagnostics Preview** (`io.github.pine.emu.diagnostics.preview`),
version `2.1.2-diagnostics-v1`. Diagnostics is off by default.

The old and initial fixed CI APKs have different Debug signing certificates.
This fresh application ID avoids requiring an uninstall or clearing old data.
It does not migrate another app's private settings, files, URI grants or exit
history. Configure lawful local content in the new app; do not share keys.
Continuous in-place Debug updates still require a stable development signer.

releases.body:
# FFmpeg 9.0.2 + dav1d 1.5.4, MinGW (UCRT64) amd64

Static FFmpeg for Eglantine's MinGW builds (`windows-x86_64-pgo`), in CPMUtil's CI package layout
(`CMakeLists.txt`, `include/`, `lib/`). crueter-ci's MinGW package has no AV1 decoder, so the AV1
movies of Switch 2 titles (Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time) played
black on those builds. This is the MinGW counterpart of Takoroka/ffmpeg-av1 `9.0.2-av1-1` (MSVC and Linux).

## Sources

- FFmpeg [`946fcce07b6dcd0331c8cc609192aeff5e1924f8`](https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/946fcce07b6dcd0331c8cc609192aeff5e1924f8)
  with crueter-ci's `0001-steamdeck.patch`
  (https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/raw/commit/ac86f96efadeac4cea0b335cffe3324f95051800/.patch/ffmpeg/0001-steamdeck.patch)
- dav1d 1.5.4: MSYS2's `mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-dav1d 1.5.4-1` static library (https://code.videolan.org/videolan/dav1d),
  merged into `libavcodec.a`
- nv-codec-headers 13.0.19.0 and Vulkan headers 1.4.363 from MSYS2

**v1.2.3: The experimental builder builds again, with the bundled nxbuild 0.6.3.**

## English

**Fixed**

emulators.latest_body:
# NSP Box 4.0.0 — Meet NUP

Smaller archives, flexible packaging, and more control over your game collection. Version 4.0 introduces **NUP Tools**, alongside the existing NSP builder.

### Package more. Store less.

- **Create compressed NUP archives** from extracted game folders, with base games, updates and DLC together in one file.
- **Choose your balance:** Fast for quicker compression, Balanced for everyday use, or Smaller for stronger compression. Incompressible files are stored raw automatically.
- **Keep what you need:** select Base, Updates and DLC independently. Choices appear after inspection, only for content present in your source. Latest-snapshot mode merges the newest selected update with the selected base, retains required base-only files, and leaves superseded versions behind. Turn it off to keep separate base/update records.
- **Avoid duplicate storage:** identical file contents can share the same space inside an archive.
- **Stay compatible:** leave files larger than 256 MiB uncompressed to reduce temporary decompression work in supported emulators.

### Convert, extract and check

- **NSP → NUP:** compress plaintext NSPs created by NSP Box.
- **NUP → NSP:** reco

- Crash and stability fixes across the renderer, audio and save states.

releases.body:
# Xenra 0.4.0

[![Patreon](https://img.shields.io/badge/Patreon-Support_on_Patreon-FF424D?style=for-the-badge&logo=patreon)](https://www.patreon.com/cw/Xanite/membership)

**Xenra 0.4.0** brings a main-thread responsiveness pass, custom Vulkan driver support for Exynos (Mali) devices, experimental temporal frame generation, FATX save streaming, and the consolidation of Xenra into a single free build.

---

## Upgrade Notice

* **Install Direct:** Install Xenra 0.4.0 directly over your existing Green installation. Do not uninstall first, or your configurations, profiles, and shader caches will be deleted.
* **Gold Edition Discontinued:** Gold is retired as of 0.4.0. Installing Green (`Ali.Xanite.green`) will install alongside Gold. Gold data remains intact on your device, but a one-time setup (selecting BIOS, game paths, and granting storage permissions) is required on Green.

---

## Highlights

### Interface & Responsiveness
* **Touch & D-Pad Navigation:** Touch target resolution defers to `ACTION_UP` without walking full view trees. D-pad navigation eliminates ~170 filesystem probes per press for instant library scrolling.
* **Background Log Parsing:** `xe.log` parsing, crash log

releases.name: Xenra v0.3.6
releases.body:
# Xenra 0.3.6

[![Gold Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Patreon-Gold_Version-FF424D?style=for-the-badge&logo=patreon)](https://www.patreon.com/cw/Xanite/membership)

**Xenra 0.3.6** introduces major compatibility, performance, and usability improvements, including GTA V gameplay, frame generation across both Xbox generations, improved GPU handling, save importing, and crucial Xbox 360 fixes.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Upgrade Notice:** Install Xenra 0.3.6 directly over your existing installation. **Do not uninstall the previous version**, or your configurations, profiles, and shader caches will be deleted.

---

##  Highlights

###  Gameplay & Performance
* **GTA V:** Resolved the `NetDll_select` scheduling issue that caused the black-screen hang. GTA V now reaches gameplay at ~25 FPS in initial testing.
* **Frame Generation:** Added frame generation support for both Original Xbox and Xbox 360, featuring **1.25×**, **1.5×**, and **2×** performance modes.
* **Core Performance:** Optimized compiled-code synchronization and streamlined several frequently executed code paths.

###  Graphics & System Settings
* **GPU Driver Persistence:** System GPU driver selection now correctly persists

releases.name: Xenra v0.3.5
releases.body:
Xenra 0.3.5 introduces direct game data management, Xbox 360 System Link support, and targeted rendering optimizations across both Xbox generations.

Buy gold version here:
https://www.patreon.com/cw/Xanite/membership

---

## Game Data Management

Access the dedicated **Game Data** menu by long-pressing any title in your library:

* **Xbox 360 Patches & Mods:** Direct installation of `.patch.toml` files (with Title ID verification) and `.xex` plugins via `plugins.toml`.
* **Xbox 360 Saves:** View saves grouped by profile; import and export ZIP archives.
* **Original Xbox Saves:** Direct FATX hard disk image integration. List, import, export, and delete saves with synchronized `UDATA` and `TDATA` handling.

---

## Performance & Rendering

* **Render Pipeline Optimizations:** Refined render-target handling and GPU synchronization eliminate unnecessary render passes, improving frame rates on mobile hardware.
* **Faster Rendering Path:** Fixed an underlying bottleneck, allowing default `gpu_upstream_conformance` to drop from 15 to 14. Existing configurations migrate automatically.
* **Visual Artifact Fixes:** Resolved queued EDRAM ownership transfer issues to eliminate image corrupti

emulators.latest_body:
This version is backwards compatible with save states from SameBoy 0.14.3 and newer, as well as save states from any BESS compliant emulator

## New/Improved Features
* Better ZIP file compatibility in iOS
* Added keyboard shortcuts for the VRAM and Memory Viewers in the Cocoa frontends
  * VRAM Viewer tabs can be switched using ^1 - ^4
* `0x` can now be used an an alternative hexadecimal prefix in the debugger and Memory Viewer

## Accuracy Improvements/Fixes
* More accurate emulation of invalid MLT_REQ SGB commands
* Fixed a bug where certain Game Boy Printer margin configurations were not emulated correctly
* When emulating an RTC cartridge in Sync-to-Host mode, the RTC will now correctly halt if instructed by the ROM
* Improved Game Boy Printer accuracy and timings
* More realistic IR emulation, fixes IR features in certain games
* Improved DAC emulation, especially on pre-GBC models
* Improved LFSR stepping on pre-GBC models
* Emulate a quirk where square channels keep running "in the background" after their timer expired on pre-GBC models
* On pre-GBC models, the duty cycle of square channels is now latched between frequency clocks
* Improved emulation of Wave RAM corruption

Coffee GB 2.1.6 adds BESS save-state interchange, expands Game Boy peripheral support, and brings connection choices and device controls together in the desktop menu.

- Load and save BESS-compatible states from the File menu, with validated ROM matching and interchange for supported DMG, CGB, and SGB configurations.

releases.body:
This release fixes Razor Freestyle Scooter multiplayer startup and race disconnects, and keeps netplay input logs available only as an internal diagnostic feature.

- Starting netplay in Razor now lets the host coordinate a fresh boot of both games with the link connected. The reboot explicitly bypasses autosave loading on both machines.
- Opposing directional inputs are resolved consistently, preventing the race disconnect reproduced from a supplied input log.
- Netplay diagnostic logs capture every player's input and rollback timing. They are hidden and disabled by default; developers can opt in with `-Dcoffeegb.netplay.inputRecording=true`. Ordinary input recording and playback are unchanged.

SDL Renderer has been the backbone of graphics on Ymir... until now. Ymir now supports Direct3D 12 and Metal (with Vulkan to come in the future), which will enable implementation of shaders and resolution scaling down the line. Direct3D 12 also supports hardware-accelerated VDP rendering, offloading heavy graphics computations to your GPU for a significant performance boost with no accuracy compromises -- it's as accurate as the software renderer, save for undiscovered bugs. Other graphics backends will eventually support acceleration as well, hang tight!

The Virtua Gun has been promoted to a stable feature after numerous bug fixes and accuracy improvements that made it work flawlessly with most supported games. Known issues are listed in #787: only one game doesn't register shots, and three don't recognize reloads consistently.

This release brings a large set of bug fixes and accuracy improvements once again guided by @celeriyacon's test ROMs, pushing compatibility to just over 94%! A workaround for 16 games described below would bring this number to 94.6%.

The highlight of this version is the huge set of fixes to CD Block HLE, bringing more parity with the LLE counterpart and improving compatibility and stability with dozens of games. VDP1 fixes also resolved a few longstanding issues and brought some games to life.

releases.body:
Changes since the latest beta release:
- Fixed two UI issues (#843, #846)
- Fixed a bug in the CBM file system implementation (#853)
- Fixed a bug in the drive idle logic (#854)
- Fixed three drive-related VICE tests (#668, #674, #675)

Core and API

* Public API: The API now has as new shape. There are async counterparts (…Async) for state-changing calls, set is now setAsync, there is a new MemoryDebugger API, more getters, and suspend/resume coverage across the API.
* Threading: The command queue and message queue are now std::deque-based. Messages can carry exceptions. AudioPort is thread-safe. Cmd::CALL, TRACK_ON and TRACK_OFF are new.
* Messages: Msg::CONFIG is sent for every option change. ROM_LOADED, RSH_DONE and CONFIG_ERROR are new.
* RetroShell: It has the new architecture from vAmiga, with multiple shells and a single console per shell.
* Workspaces: A screenshot is now saved inside saveWorkspace().
* X-Ray: GPU X-Ray support is added, with a new XRAY_COMPOSITOR option.
* Shared libraries: utlib and rvlib were merged with the versions shared with vAmiga and Silicium.
* Cleanup: Header, include and namespace cleanups, plus removal of orphaned files.

Fixes

* Drive::isIdle() is fixed (#854).

This maintenance release primarily addresses issue #851, which prevented the app from running on the upcoming macOS 27 Golden Gate. It also includes internal code changes required to make the core compatible with the architecture of the upcoming Silicium emulator.
Removing beta status, as no significant bugs have been reported for some time.

## Refactoring

This beta release introduces substantial changes to the underlying code base. As part of the development of the RetroVault app, a new **RetroVault** library has been created. This library is now responsible for managing:

- File systems  
- Devices  
- All supported image formats  

RetroVault is designed as a standalone library and is also used in the latest version of vAmiga for the same purpose.

In addition, the new **utlib** library has been introduced. All utility functions previously embedded in vAmiga and VirtualC64 have been refactored into this more powerful shared library. This makes it easier for me to share common functionality among the different emulators. 

## Enhancements

- The disassembler now supports symbol files (#837)

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a crash in the file system importer when importing excessively large folders (#841)  
- Fixed a bug in the VIC inspector that prevented selecting individual sprites in Tahoe (#840)

New features: 
- AGA support

# Release Notes

## Enhancements

- The floppy disk API now supports disk images stored in memory buffers (#992)
- Added proper gamma correction to the palette builders (#998)
- Replaced the 4096-entry palette lookup table with a smaller table based on an affine transformation, paving the way for AGA support.

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a bug that caused the server launch daemon to fire every cycle (#990)
- Fixed a bug that prevented preferences from loading correctly (#995)
- Added guard checks for potential Swift `nil` values
- Fixed a bug in the **Export to…** menu (#989)
- Reverted pull request #837 (#984)

Ending the beta phase, as no severe bugs have been reported recently.

## OpenROM v4.0.0

Universal Retro Gaming Toolkit for retro gaming enthusiasts.

Each download includes:
- **OpenROM** — Flutter desktop GUI
- **openrom-core** — headless CLI (used internally by the GUI)

### CLI usage
```
openrom-core --detect game.iso
openrom-core --input game.iso --format CHD
openrom-core --folder /roms/ --format CHD --compression Max
openrom-core --list-formats
```

### Supported Formats
- PS1/Dreamcast/Saturn/Sega CD: BIN/CUE → CHD (createcd)
- PS2/GameCube/Wii: ISO → CHD (createdvd), CSO, RVZ
- Xbox: ISO → CHD (createdvd), CSO (XISO via community extension)
- PSP: ISO → CSO
- Universal: ZIP/7Z compression, IPS/BPS/xdelta3/DCP patching

emulators.latest_body:
Copperline 1.1.0 is the first feature release of the 1.x series. Hard drives can now run at the speed of the period drives each Amiga shipped with. The MMU-less 68EC030, 68EC040 and 68EC060 are new CPU choices. The JIT is much faster on fast-RAM code and heavy disk I/O, and has a new "fastest" speed. A500 CIA, interrupt and bus timing are corrected against measurements of a real A500. It also includes every fix made on the 1.x branch since 1.0.1.

releases.name: Copperline 1.0.1
releases.body:
Copperline 1.0.1 is the first maintenance release for 1.0. Most of it fixes problems reported against 1.0.0: an AGA display fetch error, a blitter race on fast CPUs, warm reboots on the A3000 and A4000, the 68060 FPU at reset, the copperhf hard-disk driver, and a window-resize hang on Windows. Menu settings are now remembered between launches, and screenshots save the picture as you see it.

## Before upgrading

- **Netplay peers must all run 1.0.1.** Players and spectators need the same build.
- **Recreate RetroArch save states after updating the core.** The core's states carry a build fingerprint that includes the release version. Desktop `.clstate` files still load: the save-state format has not changed, and a 1.0.0 state resumes byte-for-byte as it does in 1.0.0.
- **Settings changed from the menu are now saved.** In 1.0.0 they lasted for the session. Now a change made from the menu, a hotkey or the status bar is written into your saved default configuration, which is created if you do not have one. Sessions started with `--config`, a `./copperline.toml` or `--factory` leave their files alone, and scheduled headless runs never write. See [settings the menu remembers](https://co

releases.name: Copperline 1.0.0
releases.body:
Copperline 1.0.0 is the first stable release. It follows two weeks of testing of 1.0.0-rc.1 and is the 23rd release since the source went public on 14 June.

This release adds Smart framing and native 1:1 screenshots, more control over where and how the window opens, VHD hard-disk images, a fix for AGA sprites that use scan-doubling, and a Check for updates button that only contacts GitHub when you press it.

## Copperline 1.0 at a glance

- **Machines:** A1000, A500, A500+, A600, A1200, A3000, A4000, CDTV and CD32, with OCS, ECS and AGA chipsets and 68000 to 68060 CPUs, FPUs and MMUs.
- **Accuracy:** the CPU and custom chips run on one colour-clock timeline, with the chip bus shared out cycle by cycle. Timing is checked against a real A1200, A4000 and CD32, and 45 test programs are compared pixel for pixel on every change.
- **Ready to run:** the open AROS ROM is bundled, as are ROMs for the A2091, A4091 and IDE boards, the CD32 FMV module and the HRTMon freezer. WHDLoad packages and Amiga programs boot directly.
- **Media and expansion:** floppy images including IPF and SCP, real drives through a Greaseweazle, IDE and SCSI hard disks, CDs, host folders, RTG graphics cards, Ethern

releases.name: Copperline 1.0.0-rc.1: the first release candidate for 1.0
releases.body:
This is the first release candidate for Copperline 1.0. If testing does not turn up problems that need a second candidate, the next release will be 1.0.0.

This cycle brings three- and four-player netplay on the desktop, debugger watchpoints on device registers with a timed trace of CD32 drive commands, a refreshed AROS ROM, and a review of the whole manual against the program, which also found and fixed a few mismatches in the program itself.

Please try your usual games, demos and configurations with it. Anything that worked in 0.21.0 and does not work here is exactly what a release candidate is for: [open an issue](https://github.com/CopperlineHQ/Copperline/issues) with the configuration and the software involved.

## Before upgrading

- **Netplay peers must all run 1.0.0-rc.1.** The wire protocol moved to version 3 to carry up to four players, so a 0.21.0 peer cannot join.
- **Recreate RetroArch save states after updating the core.** The core's states carry a build fingerprint that includes the release version. Desktop `.clstate` files from 0.20.0 and 0.21.0 still load; states from 0.19 and earlier do not.
- **High-density floppy images are refused.** Copperline's drives are do

releases.name: Copperline 0.21.0: spectators, four controllers and desktop fixes
releases.body:
Copperline 0.21.0 adds spectators to Netplay, connects four local controllers on desktop and in RetroArch, and reduces the work needed to put each frame on screen. It also fixes file-picker crashes and changes two defaults that could upset otherwise working games.

## Before upgrading

- **Clipboard sharing is now off by default.** It fits an extra autoconfig board, which changes the Amiga's memory layout. That caused a hang in Lotus Esprit Turbo Challenge under 0.20. Enable it explicitly with `--clipboard` or `[clipboard] share = true` when you want it. An existing configuration that explicitly enables sharing keeps doing so.
- **The CD32 FMV cartridge is now optional.** A stock CD32 starts with an empty cartridge slot. To use the bundled open FMV ROM, select **Fit** in the launcher's FMV row or set top-level `fmv = true`. A named `fmv_rom` still fits that ROM. Configurations that relied on the old implicit default need this setting for FMV playback; ordinary CD32 games no longer inherit the cartridge's changes to memory layout and boot timing.
- **Use matching builds for Netplay, including spectators.** Desktop connects to desktop; browser connects to browser. There are still two

# Lua Scripting
- Added Lua 5.4 scripting: `File > Script > Lua` opens a script editor on win32, Qt and GTK, with syntax colouring, line numbers, completion, an API reference, a console and session restore.
- Added a script debugger: breakpoints (with conditions, hit counts and log messages), Step Into / Over / Out, Break on Errors, and Variables, Watch, Call Stack and Breakpoints panels.
- 28 example scripts under `Help > Examples`: FPS Counter, Sprite Boxes, RAM Heat Map, Input Display, Cheat Finder, Trace Logger and more.
- `-lua <script>` runs a script from the command line.
- `gui.set_antialias` smooths lines, circles, ellipses and polygons.
- No speed cost while no script is loaded.
- Guide and API reference: [Lua scripting](https://github.com/shanytc/snes9x/blob/master/docs/lua-scripting.md)

# Enhancement Chips (DSP-1/2/3/4, Cx4)
- DSP-1, DSP-1B, DSP-2, DSP-3, DSP-4 and the Cx4 now run as native chips that match their firmware instruction for instruction, with no dump needed.
- Each chip can also run its firmware dump (new BIOS Manager slots), or the old HLE.
- The BIOS Manager picks `Legacy (HLE)`, `Native (LLE)` (the default) or `Firmware` per chip, with a speed chart com

# Nintendo Super System
- Added Nintendo Super System arcade support: Z80 supervisor, 
- key chip, on-screen display, three cartridge sockets and the front panel.
- Twelve of the thirteen dumped cartridges run, including HiROM and DSP-1 boards.
- Named the cartridge DIP switches for ActRaiser, The Addams Family, Lethal Weapon and Robocop 3.
- The supervisor's reset silences the APU too, Restart has to be held as on the cabinet, and nocash's test program is accepted as a BIOS.
- The joypad watchdog is off by default. Fixes Lethal Weapon being thrown off the machine.
- Added hotkey tabs
- Load with Preview now shows previews

# Nintendo Super Disc
- Added support for the BIOS in the BIOS Manager.
- Added support for disc insert and eject (eject resets to the home screen), and the disc's name in the window title.
- Working Titles:
  - Super Boss Gaiden
  - Test CD, [sdtest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32607729/sdtest.zip)
- Added hotkey tabs
- Load with Preview now shows previews

# Super Famicom Box
- The keyswitch position is remembered, and the window title names the running game.
- Added a Super Famicom Box menu (coin, keyswitch, OSD language and backdrop), moved

# Super Game Boy Color (new, Experimental)
- New SGBC mode: an SGB2 with a Game Boy Color inside with customs borders support.
- This mode runs a memory patched SGB2 BIOS with per-game in-memory patch to support colors and borders.
- Color now comes from the cart instead of the stale SGB palette. 
- Pre-palette fallback goes through BGP.
- DMG-compatibility color is routed through BGP/OBP.
- Carts whose SGB detect beats the Color branch get dedicated patches.
- Note: not all games might work out of the box - some issues might occur during game play / boot.

# Super Game Boy
- MLT_REQ is latched in the ICD2 instead of waiting for the BIOS.
- BIOS mode carries its cycle remainder instead of flooring twice, and deducts GB cycle overshoot (fixes audio pacing).
- Packet bits latch on the rising edge, not the falling one.
- MASK_EN honored on the BIOS pane, LCD-off treated as a freeze.
- Boot logo held on displayed content, hidden under the SGB BIOS, and shown only when a boot ROM was actually assigned.
- GBC-only carts are no longer forced out of SGB BIOS mode on the container path.
- Sprite-limit hack offered in SGB BIOS sessions.

# Game Boy 
- Mode 3 split into a timing skeleton and

# Emulation

## Voicer-kun
   - Play Voicer-kun enabled games by attaching the included audio CDs with the game (can be in cue/bin files format,  or .zip containing cue/bin); 
   - Voicer-kun IR peripheral is fully emulated so the games drive the CD themselves.
   - Menu placed under Sound => "Voicer-kun"
   - Only one disc can be attached in the drive at a time (EMIT requires to change CDs during the game).
   - Port 2 is forced to a joypad as attached device so that the voicer-kun device is detected.
   - IR burst looped so the learn wizard registers keys automatically, port 2 reports only the device id, not player buttons.
   - IR burst will work when selecting the game's automatic mode (not manual)

     - EMIT Vol. 3 (CD1, CD2)
     - Angelique (CD1)

   - `Allow Invalid VRAM Access` override for games that need it, surfaced in Win32/GTK/Qt with proper enable/gray-out handling.

emulators.latest_body:
## 1.0.47 (2026-11)

### New
- Stick anti dead zone, in Settings, Controls, Stick range, and for each
  game in its own Controls. Many Xbox games ignore the first part of a
  stick's travel themselves (they were made for the original controller's
  loose sticks), so even with the dead zone at 0 a small push does
  nothing. In Chicago Enforcer, for example, the view doesn't turn at all
  until the stick is about a third of the way over. The anti dead zone
  makes the smallest push past the dead zone start at that amount, so
  the game reacts straight away. Both stick boxes on the Stick range
  screen draw it as a red disc, next to the dead zone's grey ring.
- A game's Controls now have its own sticks (dead zone, anti dead zone,
  range, shape) and triggers, so each game can be set apart from the
  global settings. Thanks to crashmidnick25 for the report (#84).

releases.body:
## 1.0.46 (2026-11)

### Fixes
- Less audio stutter on Linux in games with a lot of sound going on,
  like Forza Motorsport's races. The emulated sound chip's voices were
  split between the audio thread and a helper thread, and on Linux
  waking the helper and waiting for it 1500 times a second cost more
  than the work it took over. In a Forza race the audio thread was busy
  about three times as much on Linux as on Windows on the same machine,
  and on slower laptops it couldn't keep up. On Linux the audio thread
  now does the voices itself, which takes it from around 20% busy to
  around 7% in that race. Windows keeps the helper, which pays off
  there. Thanks to saultsomy-jpg for the report and the detailed log
  (#82).

releases.name: xbased 1.0.45
releases.body:
## 1.0.45 (2026-11)

### Fixes
- Chicago Enforcer no longer freezes when starting a new game. Its
  loading screen works with events it opens by name, and the emulator
  had no way to open an object by name, so it stopped right there. Named
  events, semaphores and mutants are now supported, and a name goes away
  with the last handle to it, as on the console, since the next loading
  screen waits for exactly that. The game now gets through both loads
  of the first chapter and plays. Thanks to P1Login for the report (#56).

releases.name: xbased 1.0.44
releases.body:
## 1.0.44 (2026-11)

### Fixes
- The updater on Windows no longer gives up on an update that unpacked
  fine. It unpacks the new version with Windows' own tar, and on some
  Windows 10 machines tar reported an error even though every file came
  out right, so the updater stopped and opened the releases page
  instead. Now, when tar reports an error, the updater checks every
  file of the package against the download (its name and size) and
  carries on if they're all there. Thanks to shadowflash for the report
  (#76).

releases.name: xbased 1.0.43
releases.body:
## 1.0.43 (2026-11)

### Fixes
- Crimson Skies: High Road to Revenge no longer goes back to the
  dashboard as it starts. Some games check that the disc is an original
  by reading its security sector, which lives in a part of the disc that
  disc images don't include, and the emulator handed back zeros. The
  emulated DVD drive now makes a security sector that passes the game's
  check (the right time stamp and checksum, signed with a key of
  xbased's own, which the emulated console uses as its public key). The
  game now boots and plays. Thanks to BlueDragon992 for the report (#80).

releases.name: v2.5.0
releases.body:
## Highlights

- **Disk images are kept unmodified with a save directory.** With `-saveDir`, what the software writes goes to an overlay file there and the image is only read. Overlays store only the tracks or blocks written and are tied to a checksum of their image. This also makes writable the disks that could not be written before: inside a zip or gzip, loaded from a URL, or embedded in the executable.
- **DOS 3.3 boots in five seconds.** The Disk II motor keeps turning for about a second after the drive is turned off, like the 556 timer of the real controller, and the data latch no longer reads the same nibble twice. DOS no longer waits for the motor on every access: a DOS 3.3 boot takes 5.4 million cycles instead of 36 million.
- **A libretro core** runs izapple2 inside RetroArch and the other libretro frontends, with diskette swapping from M3U playlists and saves as overlays. It is built from source and is not in the release archives. See [the libretro page](https://github.com/ivanizag/izapple2/blob/master/doc/frontend_libretro.md) and [the Mac guide](https://github.com/ivanizag/izapple2/blob/master/doc/frontend_libretro_macos.md).
